tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar snyan ngag gi bstod pa dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// maḥs ra s+s+wat+yai// skyob pa kun dga' rin chen zhabs kyi rnam thar tshigs bcad mchod bstod snyan ngag gi 'brug sgra zab mos dngos grub kyi char rgyun rtag tu 'bebs nus pa brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs chen po zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'chang dngos skyob pa yab sras la/ rnam thar snyan ngag bstod phreng 'di 'bul gyi// thugs rje'i phyag gis rings par bzhes nas kyang*// byin rlabs char rgyun da lta dbab tu gsol// yid 'ong kun gsal dpal mo chos 'byung*// rdo rje phag mo'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul chen// chos kun gshis sam babs kyi gnas 'dir// rig pa skad cig rang gzugs lha sku// sku gsung thugs gsang mi zad rgyan 'khor// li tsa gzhon nu'i smon lam 'ja' gur// klu sgrub skye ba tshon brgyas spud pa'i// lha bab skyu ra'i gdung khyim yangs por// theg pa rim dgu'i rin chen khri la// sdom gsum pad zla nyi ma'i gdan brtsegs// khri thog bcu gnyis g.yas g.yon drug 'gyogs// thabs shes phar phyin drug drug dbus na// kun khyab sngo sangs mdangs 'phro'i sku ni// dga' bzhi'i nyams kyis lhag par brjid chags// rin chen in+d+ra nī la'i zhabs zung*// ngo mtshar 'khor los mtshan pa la sogs// sum cu rtsa gnyis ya mtshan gyis mdzes// rdo rje'i skur mtshon skyil dkrung gis bzhugs// rgyu 'bras stong nyid rdo rje'i phyag g.yas// shes byar srid tshad dril bu g.yon 'khrol| |thabs shes bsnol bas sangs rgyas mdzad sgrub// lnga ldan yid bzhin nor bus dbu brgyan// rgyal ba rigs drug rus pa'i rgyan dang*// yum drug rin chen rgyan du mdzad mkhas// stobs sogs bral 'bras yon tan so gnyis// lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' gsol zhing*// sen mo dmar sogs dpe byad brgyad cu// rnam par bkra ba'i 'od zer 'bum 'gyed// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong zhal sgos// yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs kyis rtag tu// gdul bya'i sems la 'bab pa'i chos ston// kun tu dga' bzhi'i dpal la rol ba'i// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po'i thugs mnga'// yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang khyod// bka' brgyud bla mas sprin phung ltar bskor// yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum sder bcas la| |bdag gis mchod dang bstod 'di 'bul lo// rang bzhin brjod rgyan gser gyi sa gzhir// dpe rgyan lcags ris khor yug bskor dbus// gzugs can ri rgyal lhun po brjid chags// gsal byed rgyan mdzes shar du lus 'phags// skor rgyan 'dzam gling las kyi sa pa// 'gog rgyan nub gling ba lang longs spyod// don gzhan bkod rgyan sgra mi snyan byang*// zlog can srid can lus dang lus 'phags// shar gling gtso mo gsal byed gdong mdzes// gling g.yog zlog srid zur mig ston mkhas// snyan ngag sbrang rtsi skyug pa'i bung ba// 'dod pa'i rkang drug g.yo ldan ma rnams// 'gug nus pad dkar lcags kyu 'di dang*// bsdus dang phul byung rnga yab de bzhin// lho gling gtso mo skor rgyan khams drug

/gdong mdzes g.yo la gling g.yog dkar dmar// glog phreng gsar pa'i 'du 'god kyis bris// ngang mo'i khur 'dzum rlabs phreng 'khrugs pa'i// bskyed rim yongs grub chu gter dbus na// gtum mo 'bar 'dzags bde stong bskul ba'i// mgrin bsgyur dri za'i dbyangs la mkhas mas// sku bzhi'i lang tshor gyur ba'i bshes gnyen// thugs rje chen po'i chags pas myos nas// slob ma skyong la sgrin 'grus gyur pa'i// mdza' bo mchog rnams 'bral med rtog par// 'ching nus bdug spos zhags pa 'di dang*// rab brtags rgyu yi g.yo ldan lam mchog /nub gling gtso mo 'gog rgyan tshems dkar// rab brtags rgyu yis ston la mkhas pas// mtshan ldan bla ma'i thugs bde 'khul nus// phra mo cha rgyan sgra mi snyan dang*// sgra mi snyan zla byang gling g.yog gnyis// gtso mo don gzhan bkod pa'i smin 'khyog /gling g.yog phra cha lan bu'i chun 'phyang*// de ltar nub gling dam tshig sdom pa'i// thabs shes lcags sgrog mar me dang ni// byang nas thabs shes dril bu dri 'bul// rim pa'i rgyan mdzes gser gyi ri bdun// dga' rgyan dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon shing*// nyams ldan 'dod dgu'i ba mchog yid 'ong*// gzi brjid can gyi ma smos lo thog /'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma dbu mar son pa'i// du ba smig rgyu mkha' snang mar me// mchod bzhis sku bzhi'i bla ma khyed mchod// rnam grangs brjod rgyan rtsibs stong 'khor lo// kun tu phan rgyan yid bzhin nor bu// rgya che dga' ba bskyed pa'i btsun mo// snyon 'dor blon po

rin chen dang ni// sbyar rgyan theg pa'i glang po che dang*// khyad rgyan mtshungs sbyar cang shes rta mchog /dga' rgyan dmag dpon rin chen yang 'bul// skabs min bstod rgyan gter chen bum bzang*// rin chen sna bdun gter bum dang brgyad// rnam shes tshogs brgyad steng gi chos dbyings// 'jig rten chos brgyad dri ma bkrus te// rnam thar brgyad kyi ngo bor dmigs nas// bla ma'i sku lus gzhal med khang chen// 'degs byed ka ba brgyad kyi rnam pa'i// sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad tshul du phul bas// byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad mnyes nas// sgo mtshams brgyad kyis byin gyis rlobs la// sgrub pa bka' brgyad nyams su len tshe// gu ru mtshan brgyad lta bur sprul te// thun mong grub chen brgyad po grub nas// gzung 'dzin rtog pa brgyad po 'gag cing*// mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po mthar phyin// phyi yi dur khrod gnas brgyad nyul nus// nang gi rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas 'gyur// gsang ba'i dbang phyug brgyad po thob las// gnas gsum pho nya brgyad tshan gsum sogs// sku gsung thugs 'khor brgyad tshan mi zad// dam tshig 'khor lo brgyad tshan gyis kyang*// he ru ka dpal zhal brgyad tshul du// yon tan phrin las brgyad tshan brgyad stsol// slar yang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di ltar// zol bstod rgyan gyi sgeg mo gzugs mdzes// 'od gsal stong gzugs gsang ba'i mchod 'dis// a wa dhū ti'i bla ma dgyes mdzod// nges par bstan rgyan phreng ba ma ni// dwangs ma dkar dmar mu tig phreng mdzes// 'gro 'ong 'gog pa'i srog rtsol srad bur// stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis spel lo// lhan cig brjod rgyan glu ma nyid kyang*// 'gyur khugs stong ldan pi wang gling bu// rnga zlum rdza rnga'i sgra dang lhan cig /gzhom med rol mos mchod la brtson no// yongs brjes rgyan gyi gar mkhan ma yang*// stangs stabs brgyad dang gar dgu'i sgyu rtsal// drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gsang mchod 'bul mkhas// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang ba'i// bla ma mchog khyod bde chen mchod bzhes// dga' dang snying rje stong nyid bcu drug

/phyag dang thod mtshan bcu drug brtas stsol// 'jigs bcu drug las skyob par mdzod cig /slar yang shis brjod rgyan gyi mchog ni// thabs shes nyi ma zla ba'i mchod 'bul// 'od bzang ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od dang*// nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes pa'i// thabs shes bla ma dgyes pa'i dngos grub// chu bo gyen zlog nyi ma mtheb gnon// de nyid bcu drug bden don bcu gnyis// rdo rje'i nyi zla grub chen mdzod cig /de nas rab spel rgyan gyi gdugs mchog /brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan// phrin las lhab lhub zad med 'bul zhing*// dgongs rgyan rgyal kun bstan pa gcig pa'i// chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'thon por sgrengs te// zung rgyan che chung bya bla dka' dang*// gab tshig sgra rgyan lha mi'i mchod rdzas// kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin// 'bul lo dngos grub char rgyun phob cig / rang bzhin rgyan rigs brjod/ kun khyab chos sku'i zhing na rgyal ba rnams// rtag tu longs spyod rdzogs skus chos ston bzhin// bzo dang skye dang byang chub mchog sprul pas// ma dag zhing du don mdzad dngos po'i gshis/ rang bzhin gnyis pa bya ba brjod/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyis rgyas sras li tsa bī// sku gsung thugs kyi skyin por bstsal ba des// 'phags yul klu dang ljongs 'dir skyu ra'i gdung*// bzung nas khur chen khyer ba 'di ngo mtshar// rang bzhin gsum pa yon tan brjod pa/ gsum rig siṅgha gling pas 'dab brgya'i skyes// klu sgrub skye ba'i rmad byung gtam bcas pa// shākya shrī mtshan bya ma rta yi 'phrul// 'jig rten mgon po'i rin chen dpal du brnyes// bzhi pa rdzas brjod pa/ gsum bcas bcu phrag khri dus zhal bzhes bka'// mtsho skyes lung bstan skyob pa'i bka' chems rnams// gnas dus gcig par gser khang chos rje'i skus// thugs ka'i 'ja' 'od 'gyed pa'i 'phrul de byon/

chos dpe/ ngo mtshar 'jig rten gsum mgon thugs kyi 'phrul// dam pa tog dkar thugs kyi rol rtsed ltar// gser khang dga' ldan chos rje'i pho brang nas// 'pho bar mdzad pa ya mtshan 'di ltar snang*// dngos dpe/ mthil nas mtshe'u kha sgru nang sman ljongs kun// dbang po'i gzhu yis sbrel ba lta bur ni// rab gsal tshon brgyas spud pa'i mdangs 'phro ba// nyin byed mkha' yi gur khyim lta bu'o// zlog dpe/ 'ja' 'od de bzhin glang chen thal dkar ni// sprul pa'i zhing du 'pho ba'i mdzad pa ston// skyob pa'i thugs ni dga' ldan pho brang bzhin// byams pas 'tsho ba'i dga' ldan skyob thugs 'dra// nges dpe/ sum rtsen yul gyi 'byor pa dang mtshungs pa'i// sgru nang bkra shis steng khar 'pho ba'i ltas// tog dkar ser skya'i grong du 'byon mtshungs kyi// gzhan ni 'ga' zhig dang gzhan 'dra ba med// phan tshun dpe/ rnam rgyal khang bzang dang 'dra'i yum lhums su// yab yum rmi ltas dge mtshan 'di ltar bcas// pad mtshor ngang pa ji bzhin 'jug mkhas gzhan// yod na de 'dra de yang skyob pa'i sprul// bsdus dpe/ khyod kyang phyag na rdo rje yin zhes pa// mthu stobs ldan pa gcig pus ma yin te// bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa'i rmi ltas bcas// rigs sras bskrun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang go// phul byung dpe/ mtshan ldan yum gyi dus 'khor lha tshogs kun// mngal nas spros pa'i rmi lam ting 'dzin nyams// rdo rje phag mos mngon sum nyid du ste// 'di las tha dad gzhan ni cung zad med// rab btags dpe/ stong gsum 'jig rten 'gengs pa'i rnga sgra sgrog pa dang bcas lha bu gzhon nu lha rdzas mchod pa ci yang 'bul// sa la chu mig glo bur brdol nas chu phran la gyur g.yo ba dang bcas ri dang nags la me tog 'bar// de sogs ngo mtshar rmi lam mang po ting 'dzin nyams la gsal bar shar zhes rigs yum nga rgyal bya mi dgos// dam pa tog dkar lhums su zhugs tshe sgyu 'phrul ma la'ang rmi lam ngo mtshar de 'dra mang po rmis pas so//

rmad byung dpe/ sngon tshe lum+bī'i nags su don grub kyis// gal te klu sgrub skyu ra'i skyes rabs rnams// phyogs kun gom bdun 'dor dang mnyam brjod na// khyod kyi dpal ni rgyal bu des bzung gyur// rmongs dpe/ gzhon nu khyod gsung chu shel ngos yangs por// ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan brjod ri bong gzugs// rang grub byung dus khyod gsung brtags pa na// zla ba nyid kyi rjes su sems zhugs so// the tshom dpe/ nyid sku byis pas byis pa'i tshogs rnams la// dam chos ston pa'i dbyangs snyan grag pa'i tshe// bung ba pad+ma'i rdzing bur rol lam ci// sprul pas 'gro don mdzad 'di skyob min su// gtan la phab pa'i dpe dam can rdor legs zhe sdang cha shas gter// skyengs byed byams pa'i 'dzum dkar ge sar ni// rdor legs lag pa'i skyed tshal nang skyes pa'i// ri bong pad+mos ma yin khyod thugs so// sbyar dpe/ cha shas lo bcus gang ba'i bsil zer gyis// yum gyis mya ngan tsha gdung zhi mdzad dang*// yi ge phyi mo'i ku mud ge sar yang*// skad cig gsal nus khyod gsung zla ba 'dra// mnyam nyid dpe/ nye ba'i rdo rje tsher ma bsnyel ba na// ji ltar 'tsho byed gzhon nus thub la bzhin// zhi khro rab 'byams lha dang sman bla yis// nyid drung byon pa'i mod la snyun dwangs so// smad pa'i dpe gzhon nu 'od 'bar mtshe'u kha bde ldan du// spyan drangs tshe na nyi zla 'dra ba las// nyi mas mi smra zla bas mar ngor mdzad// khyod smra rtag brtan nyi zla las khyad 'phags// bsngags dpe/ srid la dga' ba'i pad+ma'i mdzum mdangs pad gnyen nyin byed nub pa'i tshe na ge sar bsdus// mgrin ldan bung ba rtsi bcud yal ba'i chu ba bor nas dri zhim 'dab brgya'i tshal du bsnyags// pad+ma bung ba dag dang khyod mtshungs yab rje zhi bar gshegs pa'i dus der thugs 'byung ste// khu bo'i spyan sngar dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston phyir du rings par byon nas 'dod don gsol//

brjod 'dod dpe/ zhing gzhan gshegs sam bzhugs par gyur rung bdag gi yab ni nyi ma 'dra// nyi ma nub pa'am da dung 'char rung bdag lus pad+ma dang 'dra snyam// khu bo dgyes sam mi dgyes gyur na'ang bdag tshe mi rtag lho sprin 'dra// myur du thob pa'am gzhan du gyur kyang thar 'dod skom pa chur bsnyag 'dra// 'gal ba'i dpe/ de tshe khu bo dbang gis bka' bstsal pa// 'dab stong pad+ma ge sar ngom pa dang*// ston ka'i zla ba bsil zer ston pa dpa'// khyod kyi nges 'byung gtam dang gsum po 'gal// dgag pa'i dpe rang yang 'khor ba'i btson rar bcings gyur pas// 'jig rten lha la dkon mchog rnam gsum ltar// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyob nus ci yang med// sangs rgyas chos sogs bsten cig rigs kyi bu// mdzes dpe/ rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid 'gro sgrol thugs rjes chags// khyod kyi sems kyang 'gro don la chags par// mtshungs mod na yang byang chub sems dpa' de// gong nas gong du spel zhig rigs kyi bu// de nyid brjod pa'i dpe de sogs gsungs te thub bstan khang bzang du// drang po'i lam nas bde ba'i khang par bcug /'di ni lam srang ma yin theg chen yin// 'di ni khang bzang ma yin thar pa'i sa// thun min dpe/ de nas dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes skabs su// karma pa dang zu rer mjal ba'i tshe// nyi zla'i ya mtshan las 'das mgon gnyis po// gnyis po bdag rang nyid dang mtshungs par gyur// byung min dpe/ de tshe 'dzam gling 'di yi 'byor tshogs kun// gcig tu bsdus pa ji bzhin khyod drung na// lha rnams me tog 'thor zhing 'ja' gur stob 'bul ba'am mchod pa // srid min dpe/ mi rnams chos dang srid kyi 'byor pas skyid// slar yang khu bo'i spyan sngar chos gsan dus// cha shas gter las mthar byed chu rgyun dang*// gau tam bka' las bslu ba'i tshig bzhin du// khu bo'i gsung las gdams ngag min mi srid//

mang ba'i dpe/ phyag rgya chen po dkar po chig thub dang*// rtsa ba sdong bu lo 'dab 'bru lnga ldan// sman bla 'jig rten mgon po'i chos kyi mdzod// lta ba'i gdeng dang nyams len rgyur yang bstsal// rnam 'gyur dpe/ de tshe khyod kyi rnam dpyod gdong mdzes ni// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las bton ji bzhin gsal// kun dpyod pad+ma'i mngal nas phyung bzhin gtsang*// brtson 'grus rta mchog lcag gis bskul ltar bskyod// phreng ba'i dpe/ de yang kye rdor la sogs rgyud gzhung dang*// rtsis sogs tha snyad rig pa'i rnam grangs la'ang*// rnam dpyod rtsal la nan tan gyis bskul bas// rta bdun gyis ni rta ljang can gyis nyi 'od zer la bzhin// nyi 'od mkha' bzhin mkhas kyang yul kun la// ji bzhin khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab// ngag don dpe/ sngon dus khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis// thub pa'i zhal skyin tshogs kyi gtso bor bskrun// de tshe rten la chos sku nyid bzhugs bzhin// dus 'dir dbang gi thugs dam rten gyi gtsor// bde gshegs sku bzhengs khyod kyi rab gnas tshe// dam tshig rten la ye shes chos sku'o// ngag don dpe gnyis pa/ mgon med zas sbyin ji bzhin khu bo dbang*// thub pa'i sku bzhin dbang gi thugs dam lha// ston pas gnang bzhin karma pas rab gnas// mdzad cing khyod kyang ye shes la 'jug brtson// rten la ye shes pa zhugs mang gyur kyang*// dag snang 'ba' zhig 'char khyod 'dra gzhan med// bdud rtsi'i dpal 'dzin sa brtol yongs 'du'i shing*// dpag bsam rkang 'thung gnyis pa yod ma yin// mtshungs dpe/ sa ra ha yi sprul de mtshe'u khar glo bur mgron du lhags// klu sgrub sprul khyod gnyug mar gnas pa yon gyi bdag /de nyid byang phyogs 'brog sde'i tshogs la thar lam ston// khyod ni yul der karma pa la rim gror mdzad//

rgyu'i dpe/ de tshe chos grags rgya mtshos khyod la sngon gyi skye ba dran pas bstod// li tsa bī khyod snying rje'i bsil zer rtag tu 'phro bas zla ba 'dra// klu sgrub khyod ni gtam rigs bstod tshogs 'od brgya byin pas nyi ma bzhin// 'jig rten mgon khyod dgongs gcig zab pas rgya mtsho'i rjes su 'gro zhes so// de ltar rang bzhin rgyan bzhi dang*/ dpe rgyan sum cu rtsa gsum po// so bdun dkyil 'khor mchod rdzas 'di// skyob pa rin chen lhun por 'bul/ skya bo'i mtshan rin chen lhun po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa yar bcad dge bsnyen la bstod pa'o// ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ skyob pa'i dpag bsam dpyid dus bcu gsum lo'i// dpal 'dzin tshe na nges 'byung sdong bu yis// ngur smrig lo 'dab gsar du bskrun pa'i rtser// bstan mkhas yongs 'dzin me tog 'bras bus brjid// bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ nges 'byung sdong po ngur smrig lo 'dab can// bar ma rab byung 'bras ldan ljon pa de// chos lung tshogs pa'i dpyid kyi dga' ston du// byed po mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros mtshan// thub pa'i brtul zhugs mchod sbyin brgyas byin pa'i// tshul khrims spyan stong gsal ba'i mkhan po des// mtha' dag gzugs can/ kun mkhyen klu sgrub dga' bzhin rang gi lus// 'gro la rtsol mdzad rin chen dpal gang gi// ngo mtshar skye dgu yongs la bstan bya'i phyir// bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ khyod kyi gdul bya blo yi chu shel ngos// kun dga' rin chen mtshan gyi ri bong gzugs// bris nas da lta'ang gling bzhi'i mkha' la gsal// de nas kun dga'i mtshan can khyod kyi thugs// dad pa'i yal 'dab ba spu cher g.yos pas// mkhas grub dpal ldan gsung gi chu 'dzin las// zab don gdams pa'i char zim spyan drangs so// khyod thugs 'dab brgya'i bskyed mos tshal yangs por// gdams ngag char zim dus su babs pa'i rjes// lus gnad 'khrul 'khor nyi zer gyis spud pas// nyams rtogs rdzu 'phrul me tog ci yang 'bar//

yan lag can gyi gzugs can/ sor sdud sgom gyis myos pa'i mdzes ma khyod// rlung sems dbu mar chud pa'i mkhur tshos dmar// stong gzugs mig gi ut+pal dmar po can// khyod gdong gis rtags bcu po'ang dmar bar byas// yan lag gnyis pa gzugs can/ so sor sdud nyams du sogs sngon song bsam gtan gyis brtan thig le'i nang*// khro bo'i dbang po gser mdog skus brjid phyag bzhi'i gar bsgyur gzigs pa'i mthus// khyod thugs gzigs nyams 'bras bu'i tshogs dang sku lus yal 'dab lcog rtse'i steng*// ye shes mgon po'i glu dbyangs gar gyis rlung gi shugs kyis gsung sku'i glu zhes gar bsgyur to// kun dga'i mtshan 'chang shākya'i tog khyod khra ba kha gnas bya rgod phung rir nyid kyis bshams pa'i sbyor drug khri la ting 'dzin gang du ting 'dzin sgo rnams ma lus 'dus pa'i rgyal po phyag rgya chen por zhugs//

yan lag mang po'i gzugs can/ de tshe nyid sku rnam kun stong gzugs ba spu'i khung bu re re nas kyang mdo sngags sangs rgyas ji snyed sku dang bka' brgyud bla ma'i 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu rnam par 'phro// ro rkyang rlung bcu dbu mar son pa'i phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas mthun par rab bsngags dga' bde'i 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i me tog gsar pa'i skyes dang bcas te rang rang sras rnams khyod drung lhags nas bsnyen bkur bgyid// khyod lus zhing 'di'i mi khom brgyad po'i gnas rnams sbyangs te stong nyid lag mthil ltar mnyam sa la nyams rtogs pad+mos gtams par gyur pa'i shes phyin rnal 'byor 'od dpag med zhing bde ba can du mdzad pa'o// ldan pa'i gzugs can/ de nas khyod thugs pad+mo'i ge sar rtser// mkhas grub btsad pos nā ro'i chos drug chos// 'du 'god mdzad cing gsang 'dus rim pa lnga'i// sbrang rtsi skyug pa'i dga' ston gsar spel lo// mi ldan pa'i gzugs can/ slar yang mal gro grub chen blo gros zhal// u rgyan bsnyen sgrub zla 'od 'dzum mdangs drung*// khyod thugs rtsa rlung lang tsho'i ut+pa la// kun+da'i tshal rab rgyas pa'i dga' ston yang*// nyams rtogs mtshan mo'i bung bas bdag gir mdzad// mi mnyam gzugs can/ thos pa'i 'dab brgya g.yo ba'i dkon mchog mtshan// gdams ngag 'khril shing mang pos 'degs de'i drung*// chos 'dod bsil zer spro ba'i zla gdong khyod// lhags tshe mang thos yid bsrubs spobs pa phrogs// khyad par gzugs can/ 'phrog byed dkon mchog rin chen de'i rkang pa// khyod thugs dzā hu'i bu mo'i chu gos kyi// rtse la btags tshe lha min bdud rtsis 'phongs// 'chi med dga' ston rgyal mtshan khyod rgyal gyur// 'gal ba'i gzugs can/ de ltar rngog chos la sogs dbang dang gdams// gsan pa'i chu gter bsags pa'i mtsho chen khyod// mi chos 'dzin ma'i khyim du'ang mi bzhugs par// bsnyen rdzogs lhun po'i ngo mtshar 'dzin bzhed gyur//

rgyu'i gzugs can/ dus der stan gcig khrims ldan chos lung tshogs// bcas rang bslab bya'i gting zab rgya mtsho ste// nges 'byung bslab rgyun brtan pas ri bo nyid// sgrub bya'i re ba skong nus dpag bsam shing*// sbyar ba'i gzugs can/ de tshe gsol dang las kyi gdong bzhi yi// gdong gi so thar sdom rdzogs pad+mo'i tshal// khyod thugs ngang pa'i rgyal pos nyer spyad 'os// dri zhim khyod sku'i bung bas blang 'os shes// dpe'i gzugs can/ dad gus gyis mos kun tu dmar ba yis// bkab gyur zhabs 'bring bzhin zla mdzes ldan rnams// gau tam 'khor gyi phun tshogs dmar 'od can// 'char kha'i zla bar 'gran par 'dod nas gsol// ldog can gzugs can/ skabs der mkhan po kun dga' blo gros brgya byin nyid dang las slob bstan pa gsang ston legs rin grib tshad pa sogs grangs dang mtshan nyid tshang ba'i dge 'dun mtshe'u kha bde ldan chos bzang lha yi mdun sar tshogs// lha rnams kyis ni gsol bzhi'i las tshang mi g.yo bzhag par mi 'os bcud ldan zla ba 'thungs so khyod kyis kyang ni nyis brgya lnga bcu'i bslab pa'i 'dzum mdangs yid 'ong dang ldan grogs mo'i gdong gi zla ba zhes// dge 'dun las brgya rtsa gcig po de thub bstan cha shas gang ba min yang khyod grogs so thar gdong mdzes 'di ni sdom gsum gnad gcig dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bdud rtsi yin pas khyod kyi nyams brtas so// de lta'i bla ma bcu gnyis khyim du khyod thugs nyi mas lan brgyar brgyus so thos bsam rlung 'gros sum brgya drug cu nyin rer bgrod 'di nyi 'gros ma yin dga' bzhis dbu mar bgrod 'dis sa chen bcu gnyis dbang*// smad pa'i gzugs can/ dgung lo nyi shu'i shar gyi ri bo'i spor// bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i nyi 'od 'bar ba 'dis// 'chal tshul chu skyes gdung ba bskyed byed pas// rta bdun rgyal po min zhes smad na ko//

mnyam 'jog gzugs can/ khyod gdong mkhas btsun bzang po'i zla bas kyang*// brtse ba med par gdul bya ches mang la// 'dod dang don gnyer skom pa'i gdung bskyed 'di// gdul bya'i smon lam nyid kyi skyon du bsgrags// gzugs can gyi gzugs can/ 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi khri 'phang 'dab brgya'i do ra yangs pa 'dir// mchog tshogs 'dus pa'i 'khril shing gar mkhan bshad sgrub rol sgeg gar byed pa'i// skyed tshal mchog tu khyod sku nyin byed zer phreng gzhon nu spyan 'dren mkhan// smon lam shing rta'i 'gro 'di'i bsod nams dri yi gzhon pas bskul gyur to// bsnyon 'dor gzugs can/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhing 'di kha ba can min rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul// 'bri gung se ba'i gling 'di dbu ru stod min lho phyogs dpal gyi ri// pad+mas lung bstan skyob 'di rin chen dpal min klu sgrub snying po'i sku// khri thog bcu gsum pa 'di skye bo'i lus min 'jig rten mgon gyi sprul// rab tu byung nas thos bsam sgom mdzad dang*// bsnyen par rdzogs nas go 'phang mchog brnyes la// gzugs can ngo bo'i rgyan mchog nyi shu po// mchod pa bcu phrag gnyis kyi tshul du 'bul/ gzugs can rgyan nyi shu po rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyis rang rgyud smin par mdzad pa'i bstod dbyangs kyi mchod pa'o/ / rigs brjod thog ma'i gsal byed/ khyod kyi sku yis 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi// sku yi gdul bya lhag ma smin mdzad cing*// gsung dang thugs kyis skyob pa'i gsung thugs kyi// gdul bya grol bar mdzad pa 'di ngo mtshar// bya ba thog ma'i gsal byed/ skyes so khyod sku mthong tshe rgyal ba ltar// dad pa'i me tog gsar pa gdul bya yi// skyed tshal rnams su khyod gsung thos tsam gyis// dga' spro'i lo 'dab nyams rtogs ge sar bcas//

yon tan thog ma'i gsal byed/ lhag par grags so khyod kyi snyan grags ni// khor yug ri bo'i khongs su'ang chos kyi sgra// wā rā ṇa sīr tshogs la rgyal bas bzhin// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i gtam gyis so// rdzas thog ma'i gsal byed/ khyod kyi 'chad dang rtsom dang bsam gtan mthus// gsar chos sbyin ma'i bu yi 'byor pa dag /sa yi 'og tu btang ngo bka' brgyud kyi// 'chi med phun tshogs gong nas gong du mdzad// tha ma'i gsal byed/ dus de nas brtsams mchog tshogs 'dus pa la// las 'bras gtam dang zab don 'chad pas brel// khyad par bstan snying dgongs gcig chos char yang*// thub pas bya rgod phung por ji bzhin no// bar gyi gsal byed/ bsam gtan grub rtags zad par me 'dra ba// chos drug gtum mo'i dga' ston dus kyi tshe// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros tshogs 'khor bskor ba yang*// mthun snang grub pa gdul bya mchog la'o// mnyam pa'i gsal byed/ brgya phrag bzhi ldan spong khang rab gnas la// lha rnams lha rdzas me tog char 'bebs la// nas rdog 'gron bu tsam mgo ya mtshan la// khyod dang lha dang mi rnams dus mnyam rtog / phreng ba'i gsal byed/ skyob pas khyod kyi sku spel khyod skus sbyin// sbyin pas dbul po'i bsam gang gang bas 'dus// des kyang chos nyan nyan pos sgom la 'bad// 'bad pas mos gus srog snying dga' ston 'phel// 'gal ba'i gsal byed/ bla ma rnams kyis bcol ba'i gdams ngag nor// slar yang nor bdag khyod kyi phyag tu spel// khyod kyis bla ma rnams la sngon med chos// bstsal bas thugs kyi dri ma lhag ma bsal// don gcig gsal byed/ khyod kyi bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i yid 'phrog mas// dzo ki la sogs thag rings mdza' bo bkug /bod 'brog gdul bya 'dod pa'i shing rta g.yos// 'dod ldan bya dang ri dwags tshogs kyang bsdus//

'gal don gsal byed/ jo ston la sogs nyan thos sde mang dang*// nyams rtogs ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa ji snyed// lung dang gdams ngag ci 'dod len phyir lhags// khyod ni gang la gang 'tsham ston par chas// sbyar ba'i gsal byed/ zhing mchog 'di ru skyob pa'i chos khri la// rgyun chags bzhugs nas gdul bya dman mchog rnams// chos 'khor thog mas thar dang kun mkhyen du// 'dren mdzad gsal byed bcu gnyis rgyan 'di 'bul// bstan bcos 'di nyid thog mar chos bstan tshul la gsal byed rgyan bcu gnyis bstod gis bstod pa'o// tshig bskor rgyan/ sgrub pa'i mchod pas sangs rgyas dgyes phyir dang*// sgrub nyid thub bstan snying po yin dgongs nas// sgrub po brgya phrag bzhi lhag gnas 'di ru// sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par btsugs mdzad rjes// don bskor rgyan/ sgom sde'i yul du sku yi ngo mtshar bstan// khyung po'i mdun sar gsung gi tshangs dbyangs bsgrags// sog pa rong po 'bab rom sde sogs la'ang*// sku dang gsung gis thar pa'i sa bon btab// gnyis ka bskor ba'i rgyan/ so sos yod dgu bstabs tshe thar par bsngos// rang rang 'dod don gsol tshe bag phab nas// gang gang don du gnyer tshe thun mong mchog /de de'i dngos grub bstsal bas dad gyur to// byung ba 'gog rgyan/ glegs bam gcig gis rdo rje 'chang gi bka'// ma lus tshang ba'i gzugs gnas las mi srid// 'on kyang dngos po'i nus pa bkra ba las// rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum dang bcas sngon ma byung*// mngon gyur 'gog pa/ khyod nyid bai ḍūr+ya 'dra'i shog bu la// ci phyir gser dngul yig 'brur rgyud 'bum 'god// khyod thugs la bzhugs gsang sngags snga 'gyur dang*// bcas pa'i rgyud rnams yig gzugs min nam ci// 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa/ byang hor gdug can mang po chos la bkod// kun dga' bkra shis gces pa'i bu nyid dang*// nor bcas khyod la 'bul phod da lta'i 'phrul// snying rje'i shugs ldan skyob las gzhan mi 'byung*//

chos 'gog pa/ rnam mang skye bos phul ba'i rin chen dang*// 'bru dang gos dang rta phyugs la sogs kun// khyod kyis bdag tu bzung rdzun de bden na// sgrub rgyags sogs su glo bur sbyor ba ci// chos can 'gog pa/ khyod kyi snyan par grags 'di thub bstan gyi// rgyan nam min zhes dbye ba ci las byung*// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po khyod ces sgra// 'phags yul rgya nag bar du'ang grags gyur to// rgyu 'gog pa/ phyogs mtha'i yon bdag nor yod rnams kyis nor// bu dang 'khor 'bangs can rnams grwa rgyun 'bul// dpyod 'grus can rnams nyams rtogs skyes 'bul na// lha min lam la bzhugs rnams ci zhig 'bul// 'bras bu 'gog pa/ skyob pa byon nas khri thog bcu gnyis 'das// gu ru'i lung bstan dus kyang 'dir 'grig cing*// shing de'ang s+t+wa yu ste'u yur der longs na// skyob par zhal bzhes gsal po min 'di ci// rjes gnang gis 'gog pa/ nyid rang zhal mi bzhes na'ang ma bzhes mdzod// skyob pa'i gdul bya lhag mar gyur 'di rnams// khyod las lhag pa'i skyabs gnas gzhan mi 'tshol// 'di la khyod dgongs dgongs pa mdzad mi 'tshal// dbang gis 'gog pa/ sku gsung thugs rten gsar du ches mang bzhengs// grwa rgyun gsar 'phel gnas gzhi'i zhig gsos dang*// bstan dgongs bshad dang gtso bor sgrub pa mdzad// 'on kyang khyod ni skyob par zhal mi bzhes// ma gus pas 'gog pa/ skyob pa'i gdul bya lhag mar gyur 'di rnams// lung dang gtan tshigs mngon sum gyis grub stobs// ldan gyis khyod zhal stobs mi ldan na khyod// zhal mi bzhes rung gdul bya'i gnas skabs smos// shis brjod kyis 'gog pa/ khyod la skyob par yid ches stag lung pa'i// srid 'dzin tshe dbang grags de tshe 'pho'i tshe// bdag gi skyabs su gal te mgon po de// spyan ma 'drongs na de drung skye bar shog

/ rtsub mos 'gog pa/ de skad gnyen gyi sde la brjod pa'i rjes// de rnams skyob pa'i drung du lhags nas khyod// gal te 'di yi 'dren par mi 'byon na// skyob pa'i sprul pa gzhan zhig 'dren par skyol// grogs kyis 'gog pa/ gal te mi 'byon de la rag mod kyi// phyi nas nyis stong bdun brgya'i tshogs pa yi// spyan drangs ngo ma ldog pa'i sting tshig gtam// khyod kyi bzhugs pa'i gegs gyur de gsan 'ong*// 'bad pas 'gog pa/ de nas stag lung srid 'dzin dus kyi chos gyur gang de'i re ba khyod kyis skang mdzad nas// stag lung 'dus tshogs sde dang bcas pa'ang ngo mtshar chos kyis tshim ste kun kyang ches dad gyur// gzhan dbang gis 'gog pa/ rje btsun rnam gnyis sri zhu phan tshun 'gran 'drar stabs te khyod ni gzhan nyid ngo mtshar zhes brjod bzhed lags mod// 'dus tshogs ji snyed cig dang khyod kyi ngo mtshar brjod pa su yis 'gog / thabs kyis 'gog pa/ dus de nyid na 'dzam gling 'khor los bsgyur rgyal po// sgar pa zhes byas pho nya mngags pa khyod drung lhags// khyod kyi snyan pa sngar ma gsol bas bdag rje khros// pho nya bdag gi rje 'di khyod zhabs brtan bzhed brjod// skyob pas bka' bstsal thag ring yul der ngas mi sleb// slar yang gsol pa mgon po ma phebs bzod par bgyi// mi dbang de yis chad pas bcad na skad cig gis// 'bros par nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul mchog zhig bdag la stsol// khro bas 'gog pa/ skyob pas bka' bstsal pho nya khyod kyi kha nas tshig /kho bo'i zab chos gces nor 'phrog ces nges par byung*// sgyu thabs can gyi bya ma rta khyod kho bo dang*// sa skyong gang de'i gam du khrid na'ang ci byar yod// mya ngan gyis 'gog pa/ de lta'i gnas skabs pho nyas sa skyong la gsol tshe// brtul phod zhan pas bgam la lan 'don ma nus shing*// ngas ma gnang bzhin sangs rgyas dngos lta'i rje btsun de// khyod kyis spyan ma 'drongs par 'dir 'ongs zhes skyon pa//

'gyod pas 'gog pa/ 'jig rten mgon po'i sprul pa mchog de'i zhabs drung dang bar ma sleb cing*// dad pas yid drangs spyan 'dren pho nya yang yang btang yang deng ma phebs// gdams ngag ma thob de ka'i rim pas da ni na tshod gtugs gyur zhes// bcags pa'i thugs ldan mi dbang lha sar rings par phebs nas slar spyan drangs// the tshom gyis 'gog pa/ sgar pa 'khor bcas skyob pa slob bcas bsu bar chas tshe skyid shod mi rnams 'di skad lo// ngo mtshar yid 'ong bkod pa 'di ci sum cu rtsa gsum lha zhes grags pa de dag gam// yang na grong khyer yangs pa can gyi li tsa bī zhes snyan grags ldan de'i bkod pa'am ci// bdag cag rnams kyi'ang mngon sum mthong nyan bya bar nus pas sum rtsen min zhes mdzer gyur to// sbyar bas 'gog pa/ sa skyong de yis skyob pa'i sku yi dkyil 'khor mthong nas ched brjod pa// mthong ba tsam gyis snying pad ge sar rgyas byed mtshan dpe'i 'od stong can// bdud tshogs kun+da'i tshal la sdang zhing rmongs pa'i gnyid las slong byed mkhan// khyod sku'i nyi ma 'di yod bzhin du sangs rgyas byang sems nyi mas ci//

don gzhan 'gog pa/ snyam du bsams te khyod kyi zhabs zung gtsug tu blangs nas 'di ltar bstod// 'gro ba rnams don rgyal dang de sras bshes gnyen phal pa lta bur yang*// gang 'dul skur ni yang yang sprul na'ang khyod sprul tshim pa med pa mtshar// 'on kyang sprul byed 'og min zhing gi mgon la tshim pa nam zhig mthong*// rgyu yis 'gog pa/ rje btsun khyod la klu sgrub sprul pa zhes// nam yang bdag gis bstod par rngo mi thogs// bka' brgyud chos skal bzang ba'i gdul bya rnams// gdams ngag ci 'dod khyed nyid las len to// kun khyab don gzhan bkod pa/ de skad gsol zhing dbang dang gdams ngag gsan// skyob pas mi dbang de la 'di ltar gdams// gzi ldan zla ba nyi ma nub 'gyur na// rgyal srid brtag min nges las su yis 'drong*// khyad par don gzhan bkod pa/ so ka'i chu 'dzin sar pas skye 'gro ni// ma lus pa yi gdung ba 'phrog par byed// gzhan dag rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi slad du// dam chos thob bya min nam mi dbang kye// sbyar ba don gzhan bkod pa/ lho phyogs ma la ya yi dri bzhon gyis// 'jig rten yid kyi shing rta g.yo bar byed// dkar po chig thub phyag rgya chen po 'di// dpyod ldan dpa' bo'i snying sdug ma lags sam// 'gal ba can gyi don gzhan bkod pa/ de sogs skyob pa'i gsung ni ches zab kyang*// mkhyen ldan de ni gting nas yid ches rnyed// zla ba ri bong mtshan ma'i dri ldan yang*// skye dgu dga' ba bskyed pa 'di la ltos// mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ skyob pas khyod deng zhwa dmar cod pan can// lhan cig btsad po'i pho drang po ta lar// zhabs pad yun ring bsten yang mi ngoms pa'i// sa skyong snying nas dad pa'i gdung 'di 'dra// 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ rnam thos bu yi dpal la 'gran pa'i mi yi mchod rdzas ji snyed dang*// lhas kyang me tog char chen phab pa skyob la phul nas da dung ni// ci 'bul snyam du mi dbang yid gdungs chos kyi rin thang gzhal med dang*// rgyal sras chos phyir lus 'dor nus dang 'dra bas rigs pa ma yin nam//

(mi 'os bdag bkod rgyan/)'os shing mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ dus der jo shāka yid bzhin drung du skyob pa byon pa'i ngo mtshar ni// 'khor gyis bsgrags pa mi dbang sgar pa khyod la dad pas gdungs bden mod// 'jig rten mgon khyod 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan gcig po 'dis ci ma gdungs// sprul po rang gi sprul dang bral bas skyo ba mi 'os pa min nam/ (bzlog pa gzhan bkod rgyan/)mi 'os shing 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa skyob pa khyod kyang rten mchog de yi thugs ka'i 'od zer rang la len na gdon dang rims dang than pas gzir ba'i skyid shod mi rnams skyob pa khyod la cis mi re// rims nad drag pos shi ba du ma 'ang de tshe khyod kyis slar gso mdzad na yams nad zad pa'i mthur ldan khyod kyis nad pa'i dbugs phyin lhur bzhes nyid du cis mi mdzad// so ka'i tsha gdungs than pas tshig pa'i sman ljongs zhing rnams slar yang gso phyir chu yi mngal khur lci bas non pa'i khun sgra dang ldan lho sprin bu mo'ang chu 'thor na// khyod kyi bden pa'i bka' stsal mod la chu bo che yang rgyun phyogs min par 'bab las slar ldog klu chen dag kyang rang gzugs ston na khyod kyi bka' las ci 'gong nus// de ltar bskor rgyan gsum/ 'gog rgyan nyer gsum/ don gzhan bkod rgyan brgyad po rnams kyis sgom khyung sogs rigs ma nges pa sna tshogs dang sde pa sgar pa sogs mi'i rgyal po rigs nges dang*/ klu dbang gtsug na rin chen sogs sde brgyad rgyal po dang*/ zhwa dmar cod pan sogs bstan 'dzin chen po dang*/ jo shāka sogs sangs rgyas kyang dbang du mdzad pa la bstod pa'o// gcig gi ldog pa can/ sa skyong che des khyod dang zhwa dmar gyi// cod pan 'dzin gnyis bla mar bkur mtshungs mod// khyod la lhag par dad nas gnas gsum gyi// ri bo'i spor gnas bdag por mnga' gsol phul//

gnyis kyi ldog pa can/ mi dbang de dang kun dga'i mtshan ldan khyod// snyan grags ba dan rgya mtsho'i bar du g.yo// 'di ni ma rmongs skye bo'i ljongs la dbang*// khyod ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul bdag go// sbyar ba'i ldog pa can/ stod kyi gangs dkar ti se bde mchog gnas// smad kyi tsā ri rdo rje phag mo'i zhing*// bar gyi la phyi chu dbar zung 'jug yul// dbus gtsang mnga' ris skye 'gro phal gyi'o// 'gog pa'i ldog pa can/ bla med rgyud rgyal kun las bsngags dang dri med 'od las bod na'ang nyer bzhi'i yul tshang gsungs// skyob pa nyid kyis sngon du byin rlabs grub brnyes nyis stong nyis brgya nyer lnga sogs rdzongs mdzad// de lta mod kyi thag ring bgrod dka' phyi rol bem po'i chos can nyid du 'char bas na// kun dga'i zhabs khyod ting 'dzin kha lo bsgyur dngos yul gyi 'gran zlar gyur pa ma yin no// gtan tshigs ldog can/ bde mchog la sogs yi dam ri bo'i 'khor lo gsum sogs mkha' 'gro'i gling dang khwa gdong ma sogs pho nya rgya mtsho mtha' dag 'dzin par byed pa'i sa// khyod sku bde chen 'khor lo'i ha yig pu dza la sogs rtsa khams nyer bzhi lte ba'i bar skor sde tshan brgyad yig skyob pa'i ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas// gang de'i rang mdangs nyid kyis sprul zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas gsum po dang sgrub po rnams ni kun rten yin mod phyi rol gyi ni gnas gsum po// khyod kyi bka' drin nyid las thob pa'i sgrub rgyags grogs sogs 'dzin bcas so so'i las kyi 'ching ba dang bcas phyir na skyob pa khyod kyi yul las dman// rten gyi ldog can/ phyi yul nyer bzhi gnas gsum po dang nang gi de de'ang skyob pa khyod kyis byin gyis brlabs// phyi dang nang gi khyad par yang ni phyi yul ye shes de der brten mod skyob pa'i rnam shes ye shes kyis// phyi dang nang nyid byin gyis brlabs pas kun kyang khyod kyi thugs rje'i mthu//

dpe las dpe can lhag pa'i ldog can/ ti se sogs la dga' bzhi dang*// bde chen gyis myos zil mngar med/ khyod sku'i gnas gsum nyer bzhi'i spo// yon tan 'di dag nyid kyis brgyan// mtshungs pa ldog rgyan/ khyod kyi gnas gsum phyi yi gsum dkar gsum// gtsang dang rgyas pas yid rab 'phrog pa ste// pad+ma la ni bung ba 'khor zhing rtsen// phyir ni sgrub po nyis stong nyis brgya sogs// mtshungs sgras ldog rgyan/ zla ba 'di ni mkha' yi rgyan// ngang pa 'di ni chu yi rgyan// sgrub po gnas gsum po yi rgyan// bde chen khyod sku dwangs ma'i rgyan// bde mchog 'di ni phag mo'i rgyan// dpa' bo nyer bzhi mkha' 'gro'i rgyan// sgo mtshams ma brgyad dur khrod rgyan// kun dga'i zhabs khyod zhing 'di'i rgyan// mkha' 'di rgyu skar phreng ba can// chu 'di ku mud rgyas pa can// gnas gsum nyams rtogs bskyed pa can// khyod sku rtsa rlung dwangs rgyas can// phag mo phyag rgya chen po can// mkha' 'gro nyer bzhi'i sa lam can// dur khrod chos brgyad dag pa can// zhing 'di li tsa'i smon lam can// rigs mthun ldog rgyan/ yid bzhin nor bu'i snang bas mi 'phrogs shing*// nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'gong bar mi phod pa'i// khyod sku rtsa rlung lang tsho rgyas pa las// thugs rje na chung mdzes gdong mun pa yis// zhe 'gras 'dod pas myos pa'i sgom sde dang*// chu srin rgyal mtshan gyis bskul khyung po yi// phan tshun lta ba'i mig ni ldongs byed pa// 'bri se byang chub gling gi mdzes ma khyod// ma bsgrigs rang gis 'grig pa'i rten 'brel mthar phyin skyob pa khyod mthu las// ma bskyod ngang gis sleb pa'i rdor 'dzin sgrub pos gnas gsum spo la sleb// ma phyis dwangs ba'i me long khyod thugs ting 'dzin rol rtsed las// ma bsgrubs lhun gyis grub pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bzhed dgur spyod//

phyi'i rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can/ sman dpyad ma mdzad rig sngags ma bzlas par// rgyal khams nad dang zhang tshan sde 'khrug mtshon// bskal pa zhi mdzad u rgyan lung bstan bzhin// sgrog ma dgos par skye dgu kun gyis thos// nang gi rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can/ sbor mkhan med par chu 'phan ri mes btums// gnon byed med par sdigs mdzub gdong la zhi// ma bskul gzhan don zhi las sgrub po khyod// 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i srid pa can/ ma gtsubs par ni gtum mo'i me 'bar zhing*// ma phab par yang haṃ las bdud rtsi'i char// nyi ma mtheb gnon chu bo gyen bzlog khyod// rgya gar ma 'khrungs bi rū pa nyid do// de ltar ldog pa can bcu/ srid rgyan gsum/ gnas gsum la rdor 'dzin sogs zhi rgyas phrin las la bstod pa'o// gzhan bsdus pa/ sngon gyi lha zhes rlom pa zhi bya lus med rtse 'jo'i dpal rgyas bya dang 'chi med bcud la ci dgar dbang phyir sbyin ma'i bu rnams g.yul ngor bcom ste brgya byin yul sa snga mkho ji bzhin bskyang phyir du// sum rtsen pa rnams ji ltar 'dod bzhin gsang ba'i bdag dang gang des byin rlabs lha chen u maḥde dag gis bskyed legs ldan nag dang tsartsi kā la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rol rtsed 'phrul chen du ma yis// dbang phyug dga' mar dgyes pa'i dpal las myur du bzhengs pa'i srin po'i gzugs 'dzin lcam dral dag gis lha min pham nas lha yul yun rings bde bar byas zhes gtam 'di grag go dul dus 'di na ni// kun dga'i zhabs khyod lha dang de min blang dor bral ba'i klu sgrub skyob pa'i smon lam gyis bskrun rdo rje 'dzin dang a phyi chos sgron yum drung mgon po rgyal mtshan tshul 'dzin ci dgar bsten pa 'di la ltos// khyad par can bsdus pa/ bka' brgyud mtho ris yul gyi mchog khyod rtag par 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel bzang po sgrig pa'i phyir// rgyud pa gsum 'dres rtsa ba brtan zhing dbang dang gdams pa'i lo 'dab 'bras bus brjid gyur pa'i// sku gsung bkod pa'i rkang 'thung sa rtol sdong po che zhig zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa des// 'bri se byang chub gling chen 'dir ni sum rtsen yul gyi dga' ston phyir du bstsal gyur to//

khyad par tha dad bsdus pa/ de nas khyod kyi thugs rjes gsar bskrun ljon pa'i shing chen yal ga khyon yangs me tog 'bras bu can// thag ring yul nas khur chen khyer te rings par lhags pas sdug bsngal 'gron po'i sti gnas gyur// blang dor ston pa'i grib bsil dang ldan rin chen 'bur dod yig 'bru'i rtsa ba rab brtan can// bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur srid lam gyis dub gdul bya rnams kyis sti gnas sngon med de thob bo// sngon med bsdus rgyan/ bsten na yid 'phrog sems kyi ngal so la// myangs na ro mngar 'bras ldan ljon pa ni// kye ma dus kyis rnying 'gyur 'gyur ro cog /bka' dang bstan bcos bka' brgyud gsung 'bum bcas// khyad 'phags phul byung*/ bai ḍūr+ya yi mdangs 'phro glegs bu'i gzhir// gser dngul 'bur du dod pa'i phreng ba can// spos ldan grong khyer rgyal sras chos 'phags kyi// yi dam rgyal ba kun yum e ma ho// the tshom phul byung*/ thugs dam de la rab gnas mdzad tshe kha dog sna lnga'i me tog char dang 'ja' 'od gur gyis yul kun khyab// zas gos rin chen 'bru dang rkang bzhi ches mang po dag yi ge'i rig byed mkhan po so sor stob pa'i tshe// ci 'di lha yi mchod rdzas nyid dam 'on te mi yi yo byad gang yin sngon ma mthong zhing thos pa'ang med// dus der 'dus pa'i skye bo rnams la dngos dang rmi lam gang yin snyam pa'i the tshom da dung zlog ma gyur// nges pa phul byung*/ rten 'brel mthar phyin skyob pa khyod nyid kyi// gsung gi rten la rab gnas dga' ston tshe// ngo mtshar mchog 'di mngon sum yin nges nus// gzhan du srid min 'di yis thub bstan gnas// ngo mtshar phul byung*/ dus gcig sku yi bkod pa du ma dang*// gsung gi 'chad rtsom thugs kyi rdzu 'phrul kun// rin chen dpal gyi ji bzhin 'dir mthong ba// e ma 'gro blo'i me long 'di re gsal//

sems ldan rab rtog sngon skyob rin chen dpal gyi dus nas chos dang srid kyi 'bangs su khas len lan brgyar byas pa'i rigs kyi bu dang tsha bo rnams ni 'di snyam pa// bdag cag rnams kyi pha mes de rnams nor dang bcas te rin chen dpal khong gang du bzhud sar khrid par gyur na khong gi drung du slar song ste// nor rdzas ci yod 'di rnams phul nas nged cag rnams kyi mes pho mes mo gang gang de der 'phrad par bya zhes lan brgyar bsams nas rings par rgyu// mnga' ris gu ge khams kyi 'dan ma so so'i yul nas khyod kyi zhabs drung 'bri gung byang chub gling 'dir srog dang brdos nas lhags gyur to// sems med rab rtog de tshe dbus gtsang mi rnams 'di skad ces// skyu ra 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'di// bdag cag 'di pa'i bla ma'i bgo skal du// mi mjed 'dren pas li tsa gzhon nu la// bka' bsgos ji bzhin klu sgrub ky-is khas blangs// klu yang 'od dpag med kyis myur bskul nas// bde ba can nas gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir btang*// u rgyan pad+mas sa 'di btul nas kyang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la yang yang gsung byon te// klu sgrub lha bab rgyud las zhing 'dir 'ong*// khri thog bcu gsum dus na slar yang skyar// zhang tshan 'khrugs te dbus gtsang sil bu'i dus// rnam snang zhing 'di mi g.yo rab tu brtan// skyes chen de ni nga yi gsung gi 'phrul// de lta'i bka' chems gter gyi sgrom bu nas// rtsod med byon pa bdag gis mthong min nam// rin chen dpal nyid sprul pa bsdud tshe yang*// gling 'di sgom ma ral bas 'dzin pa'i dus// shing 'di s+t+wa yu ste'u yu nyan pa'i dus// bu rgyud khri thog bcu gsum pa yi dus// kho bo slar yang zhing 'dir 'ong ba'i dus// de 'dra'i zhal bzhes gtsang ma yod pas na// kun dga'i zhabs 'di bdag cag kho na dbang*// gzhan rnams sri zhu bya rngo mi thogs par// sgrin 'grus gom stabs drag por rtsoms shog ces// mgrin gcig glengs nas bang mdzod nor rnams kun// phangs pa med par dus mnyam du thogs nas// skyob pa'i zhabs drung nyid du phung por spungs// bgrang yas skya ser mi rnams khor yug 'khod// spu nor rkang bzhi'i tshogs rnams ma shong bar// byang gi thang dang ri dang nags la'ang 'khyams// sa 'dzin rnams ni nor gyi phung po la// 'gran 'dod dpung pa gshibs nas blta bar brtsom// phal cher khengs pa bral nas nags su yib// la la steng g.yogs dkar pos mgo bo gtums// khyod 'khor bkod pa 'di lta bu// blta 'dod lho sprin 'dren pa rnams// bar snang sgron me lan brgyar sbor// ngo mtshar gtam 'di glur len pa'i// chu 'dzin bu mo'i nga ro zhig

/rgya nag rgyal po'i rna bar lhung*// le lo'i mal nas hud kyis langs// brtson 'grus gzhu mo de 'phral brdungs// dad pa'i gzhu rgyud grims po'i ngos// byang chub sems kyi mda' mo gsar// 'dun dang smon lam mtheb mdzub zung*// 'khrul 'khor kha la sbrengs se sbreng*// thabs kyi gzhu mo mer se mer// shes rab mda' mo khrams se khram// gdung shugs dngul nag bun se bun// skabs der 'phong gi rgyal pos glu blangs pa// gser smyug g.yu sgro dung gi ltong mig can// byu ru'i na bza' dbang sngon mde'us spras// kho bo'i byang sems yid bzhin nor bu'i mda'// gnod phyir mi 'phen 'bul ba'i phyir du 'phen// klu sgrub skyu ra'i chos grwar snyog par shog /bde chen thar pa'i 'ben la zin gyur cig /de skad brjod nas skad cig de kar 'phangs// de ma thag tu dpag tshad stong bgrod de// kun dga'i zhabs 'bring 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus// skyob pa'i chos khri'i 'ben la reg par gyur// skye bo yongs kyis 'ja' 'od ka bar mthong*// gtam de mkha' 'gro'i yul du grags pa las// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bya rgod du sprul nas// de la lta phyir chos nyan zol gyis lhag /rgya nag rgyal por 'gran 'dod sgyu rtsal gyis// rta rnga'i drwa mig steng du shel dkar gyi// mchod rten sgo mang skyob pa'i gzigs sngar phul// de la mgon po rgyal mtshan phrag dog nas// rin chen las grub sgo mang mod la bzhengs// rten mchog de yi gzi 'od ma bzod par// nyi ma nub kyi phyogs la mgyogs par bros// cha shas gter de ri bong gzugs phab nas// sgo mang de la ngo mtshar ci 'dug lta// de nas rgya nag rgyal pos slar bsams pa// rin chen mda' des 'ben la reg ma reg /brtag phyir pho nya rings par btang 'os snyam// tā 'bul dpon dang 'bangs bcas ches mang la// bai ḍūr+ya dang chu shel man shel dang*// ke ke ru dang pad+ma rā ga dbyig

/margad in+d+ra nī la la sogs pa'i// rin chen bdun dang gser dngul mu tig dang*// byu ru mu men zangs lcags bdun la sogs// za 'og gos dar la sogs gzan ras dang*// ga pur rgun 'brum ja la sogs pa'i rdzas// glang chen rta dang dre'u la sogs pa'i// bzhon pas 'dren du bcug ste gnas 'di ru// rgya ban brgya phrag du ma dang bcas brdzangs// yud kyis sleb nas skyob pa khyod nyid kyis// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal la ci 'dod rol//

ting 'dzin rab rtog de lta'i lugs gnyis 'khor dang longs spyod can// kun dga'i zhabs kyi ngo mtshar gtam 'di nyid// gleng bar 'dod nas mes pos gdong bzhi sprul// srin po mgrin bcur bsgyur te smra 'dod na// spyan ras gzigs kyang bcu gcig zhal ston nam// 'on kyang khyod kyi gsang 'di bsgrags min zhes// shes rab pha rol phyin ma smra gcod 'gog / skye byed kyi rgyu/ khyod kyi ya mtshan tshogs 'di blta 'dod pas// stobs ldan dgra bos mig gsum sprul pa 'dra// brgya byin mig stong sprul nas blta ba'ang snyam// thugs rje chen pos phyag stong sprul nang du// spyan stong stong yang sprul nas gzigs min nam// nyams byed kyi rgyu/ 'on kyang sku yi gsang 'di mthong min zhes// bdud ris lus la mun pa 'jug go bzhin// kun gsal dpal mo mig sman char 'bab bzhin// snyan ngag mkhan pos brtags nas khyod bstod do// rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu/ thub dbang thugs rje'i ma la ya'i rlung ni// smon lam dang sbyar dus su ldang mkhas pas// kun dga'i rdzu 'phrul tsan dan ljon pa'i shing*// gsar pa'i yal 'dab g.yo 'dis 'di na dga'// 'thob bya'i rgyu/ me tog mda' can pho brang nas 'thon dus min 'tshub ma'i dpung tshogs bzhi// chos byed ma la ya yi rlung stobs phrogs nas dge bcu'i tsan dan nags bcom nas// phan bde'i lo thog bskyed byed char zim gang las 'debs nus do ra rnams// dkrug cing gtor nas mthar byed phyir du nye bar gnas pa 'di yi dug / phyi shes byed kyi rgyu/ dug de'i yang ni dug tu 'gyur ba'i bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sman gyi mchog gyur sman pa'i rgyal po phyag na rdo rje'i rdo rje'i zegs ma ma lus bsdud mkhas rdo rje phag mo'i skyed mo'i tshal du gal te lhung bar ma gyur na// sgrub brgyud rgyud pa mchog las brgyud pa'i zab don snying por snying nas chags pa'i yid 'phrog lha gzhon gzhon nu ma lus lus dang sems bder byed pa'i bdud rtsi rtsi sman 'bab stegs dpag bsam bsam 'phel sdong po 'di mi 'khrungs la de lta na// lcags bsregs sa la la mor me 'bar 'bar byed rtse mos lus btsos pa na na tsha ma bzod bzod med skad ngan ngan smras a tsha tsha sogs ku dir du 'bod 'bod sgra kye kye skyobs skyobs yang yang bos kyang phan pa med pa'i dmyal bar ni// rings par chas pa'i skyid shod dmag mi mi kun lcags gos lcags zhwa zhwa gyon rta yang rnga mas rngam brjid brjid bskyed ru mtshon mtshon mdangs gti mug sprin gtibs zhe sdang gso sgra co sgra dung sgras thub bstan rmang nas bsgyel bar lhags pa de yi tshe//

nang shes byed kyi rgyu/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i pho nya pad+ma 'dzin des dus dang dus na dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba 'ba' zhig lhur mdzad pa las gtso bor dmyal ba'i rgyu 'gog la brtson dbu ru ka tshal zhes bya'i gtsug lag gnas gzhi 'di yang don de'i phyir du sngon gyi dus nas byin gyis brlabs// yang ni zhing 'dir las ngan rtsom pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas de 'joms rgyu ru kun dga'i mtshan ldan rje btsun khyod la nyid sku bcu gcig zhal gyis rab mdzes phyag gi pad+ma stong phrag re la'ang spyan gyi ge sar stong phrag rgyas pa'i yid 'ong sku yi gsang ba'i dga' ston bstan mdzad nas// shes byar srid tshad sangs rgyas phrin las yin pa'i gnad kas skyob pa'i phrin las nyid kyis bskul ba'i a bsod ming du grags pa 'khor bcas dmyal ba'i grong khyer shul du zhugs shing yun ring sdod pa'i cha rkyen ji snyed sgrub la 'bad pa'i dus deng nyid na dus las mi 'da' thugs rje yis// khyod sku 'dod pa'i lha bu gzhon nu yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags sprin las rdzu 'phrul dmag mi'i me tog char pa dmyal ba'i me 'dag chil chil gsod nus gdams ngag spos chu dang 'dres phab pas myong 'gyur dmyal khams stongs par mdzad 'di spyan ras gzigs dbang skyob pa khyod kyi thugs rje'i mthu// snga na med pa'i byed rgyu/ de tshe dbu ru ka tshal du// las ngan nyi ma nub pa dang*// dmag mi 'dab chags gnas su song*// khyod kyi snyan grags zla ba mdzes// zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ kha cig las 'dod kyis gzir ba// skyob pa'i zla zer gyis ma lhogs// 'bros thabs tsan dan chus ma khrus// mtshon lus drod kyis btab pa'ang snang*// phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu/ zag med mngon shes ma bsgrubs dang*// gsang sngags gzhung la'ang ma sbyangs dang*// khyod la'ang phal par log rtog pa'i// mi rnams dmag gis bcom par 'khrul// a phyi chos kyi sgron mas grogs// rta 'dzegs rgod thul gyon 'khor bcas// gzigs pas dbugs phyung de yi rgyus// pha rol las ngan 'phro bcad do//

spangs nas med pa'i rgyu/ skyob pa'i zhing khams dbu ru'i stod 'di 'du 'dzis 'tsho ba'i pha yul min// a phyi chos kyi sgron ma 'di ni gnod byed gsod pa'i sha za min// mgon po rgyal mtshan sder bcas 'di ni zhe 'gras lan 'don dmag dpung min// kun dga'i zhabs khyod rang rgyud pa min de phyir bdag cag yid dga' 'o// zlog pa skyed byed kyi rgyu/ 'phags chen rnams la ma brtags spyod pa gtan mi mnga' bas phun tshogs 'phel// skyed mos tshal gyi lhan cig byed rnams snye ma las byung ba min na// bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba gang der drag po'i phrin las mdzad 'os zhes// ma rmongs skye bo yongs kyang brtags nas khyod la bstod// ring 'bras kyi rgyu/ slar yang rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag gang gi sprul de srid zhus mnyes byed mtshon pa yi// chen po la 'os rnam mang yo byad thogs pa'i zhabs 'bring yan lag bzhis bskor khyod zhabs bskyod// khyod kyi thugs rje'i mig zur sa la lhung dus bka' brgyud lus rgyas stag lung pas// rdzas dang 'khor rnams bkur stir stabs pas khyod dang mgon de mjal ba'i dus skabs ring bar byas// rgyu 'bras lhan skyes pa'i rgyu/ yangs pa can zhes bya ba'i zhing na gnyug mar gnas pa'i sprul sku de dang klu sgrub grong nas gsar du lhags pa'i mgron po dag /bzhi mdo srang dang pho brang du yang phan tshun lus med rtog pas myos pa'i ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul ci yang ston pa 'di lta ste// mkha' la 'ja' 'od gur khyim dbus nas lha rdzas me tog lda ldi'i phreng ba gzi ra tshags 'bab gdugs dang rgyal mtshan yang ni sgreng*// lhar bcas mi rnams ca co ga zha rol mo'i skyin par khyod zhal mtshungs pa'i chu 'dzin las kyang gdams ngag char zir rgyun du 'bab// 'bras bu snga ba'i rgyu/ thugs rje'i ri dwags mig can ma khyod kyis// stag lung chos la chags pa'i rgya mtsho che// thog mar bskangs nas slar la 'od spros pas// bde chen yangs pa can du zla bar shar//

rigs min gyi rgyu/ skyob pa khyod kyi zhabs zung nyi 'od la// lhag par chags pa thang lha'i spyi gtsug gi// pad+mo'i nga rgyal ge sar zum pa ci// bsnyen bkur bung ba bskor bar khyod bzhed dam// rigasapa'i rgyu/ khyod kyi zhabs sen zla 'od gzhon nu rnams// rings par spyan 'dren ru sde kun+da'i tshal// 'brog pa rnams kyi ser sna pad+ma'i kha// zum mdzad spyan 'bras pad dkar rgyas la dbang*// zur gyi phra mo'i rgyan/ khyod ni sngon gyi skyob pa rin chen dpal de nga nyid yin zhes tshogs kyi dbus su bcom sgrog mdzad par ma bzod de lta na'ang*// sku rten sgo mang sum stong lha skus spras pa dang ni gsung rten rin chen rgyu las grub pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog /thugs rten sgrub pa nyams len byed po'i bsam gtan khang bu brgya phrag bzhis mtshon 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen gang du ci dgos phongs med sbyar// skyob pa'i gdul bya bdag cag rnams kyang thar pa'i zhing du bkri bar mdzad na rin chen dpal gyi mdzad pa lhag ma khyod ci mdzad// rnam pa phra mo'i rgyan/ khyod ni sgam po gdar gyi ri la bzhud pa min par khra ba kha ru ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig gnas tshe mdo dang sngags kyi rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mtha' dag zhal 'dzum ston la spyan zung yun ring gtad pa gang*// zhal de dag pa shel ri'i bkod pa stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo'i bde la chags pa gsal ba'i ngo mtshar ltad mo 'di 'di 'dra zhes phyi nas sprul pa'i bzo bo mched kyang ting 'dzin mthu yis myur du bkug nas sgo mang 'di// sngar byon kun las rgyu dang bzo khyad lha grangs rnams kyang gong du brtsegs te 'di ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs bzhin khams drug dag pa'i bang rim drug pa bka' brgyud pho khrom grub chen brgyad cu rnying ma'i zhi khro lha tshogs kun kyang bzhugs// lhan cig skyes sku skyob pa nyag gcig bde chen rtse 'dab bre steng so gnyis bla ma'i bang rim rgyud sde rim bzhi chos skyong bang rim dang bcas kun la phyi nang gsang ba'i chos kyi ngo mtshar mtha' dag mtshon nus byung gyur to//

'os pa'i cha rgyan/ kun dga'i mtshan ldan khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba la chags dad pa'i spu long mchog gi gdul bya'i tshogs la rgyas pa gang de thun mong gdul byas rig pa bsrung pa po ni nang gi rnam thar ngo mtshar skyed tshal bsil ba'i dri bzhon ldan 'dis byas// ji ltar nang gi rnam par nges shes rtog pa de tshe ji ltar khyod kyi mdzad pa rnams la yun ring bsams shing brtags pa'i tshe na bstan pa rgyas dang 'gro la phan mdzad e ma 'di zhes bdag cag dga' ba'i mchi mas brlan pa de tsam zhig kyang ni// skal dman gzhan ngor sba ba'i phyir du phyi yi rnam thar byis pa phal dang mthun pa'i tshul du tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i me tog grags pa'i rlung gis gtsubs pa'i rdul gyis log lta'i mig sun phyung bar bsgrags pa'i gtam 'di snyan ngag tsam zhig yin pas na// khyod kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar ya mtshan ma lus rtog pa'i dga' ston gang la phyi nang rnam thar dga' ston las kyang chags pa'i gdul bya dbang po yang rab gang dag yod pa de dag rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba phyogs tsam brjod 'di gsan par 'os// de ltar bsdus brgyan dang*/ phul byung*/ rgyu'i rgyan bcu drug phra mo'i rgyan gnyis/ cha rgyan dang po ste/ rgyan sum bcu so gnyis po ni mtshan sau gnyis mtshon pa nang gi rnam thar 'khor lo gnyis pa'i bstod pa'o/ /mi 'os cha/ khyod sku rdo rje phag mos nges bskrun gsung yang u rgyan pad+mas byin brlabs thugs ni 'khor lo bde mchog rang bzhin yon tan rdzu 'phrul mngon shes thogs med phrin las ji ltar bzhed pa mgon po lcam dral bran dang bcas pas sgrub pa gsang ba'i cha 'di gang gi phyir// rtsod dus mi rnams rang lus lta bzhin pha dang ma yis nges par bskyed dang bza' btung gos dang spyod lam gyis 'tsho na rga 'chi ba'i cha shas med na phan dang bde ba'i lam bzang ston la bag phebs yid brtan 'cha' bar mi byed bkri ba'i cha shas de phyir du// rdo rje'i phag mo'i sprul sku'i cha zhig khrus zol char bsgyur yid 'phrog lha mo dpa' bo so gad las skal ches rnyed bde chen byin rlabs bcu drug cha de mkha' 'gro'i khyim du gzhon nu'i cha lugs lha bab skyu ra gnam sbyin dkar por kun gyis yid ches de yi tshe// thog mar mkha' 'gros khrus kyi rdzing bur dbang bzhi bskur nas li tsa'i gdung bskyed bar du a phyi chos kyi sgron mas sras bzhi bskrun nas klu sgrub gdung gsos tha mar yum drung mnga' bdag rgyal mos skyu ra'i khri thog bcu gsum pa bskyangs 'di la mtshar du brtsi ci dgos//

rim pa can gyi rgyan/ sku yi gsang ba thog ma mthar rim rdo rje phag mo nyid kyis byin brlabs lha mo a phyi mnga' bdag yum gyi cha lugs so sos gnas skabs de der li tsa klu sgrub skyob pa'i bstan pa rmang tshugs dar spel slar yang gso mdzad ji bzhin du// gsung gsang gu rus byin brlabs gnas kyang ti sgro brag dang mgon khang rnying ma nyang po gad kha rnams su rim bzhin chos sku longs sku sprul sku'i rnam par pad+ma 'byung gnas mtsho skyes rdo rje ras gos gyon pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis rim bzhin du// tshe yi bcud rgyas grangs 'dzin phreng dang 'gro ba dbang bsdud lcags kyu zhags dang pha rol byad stems zhi ba'i gdams ngag thog ma bar dang tha ma de ltar rgyas dang dbang dang zhi ba'i dngos grub tshe rabs mang po'i dpon slob rten 'brel de nyid ni// sgrub byed lung rigs man ngag rim bzhin klu sgrub skyob pa kun dga'i dus gsum klu sgrub bla ma in+d+ra bhu ti skyob pa'i bla ma rdo rje rgyal po kun dga'i bla ma u rgyan gu ru pad+ma gling pa'i gter yig lung sogs thams cad 'grigs// dga' rgyan ngag dga'/ khyod thugs gsang ba bde mchog nyid// byis pa'i gzugs bzung skyob pa'i skur// mthong bas dam can yid rab dga'// ri bong gzugs kyis dga' zhing rtsen// dga' rgyan yid dga'/ de nas khyod srid bzhes pa la// dga' nas ri bong mgo drug phul// byams gsung byon la cher dga' nas// stag lung dmag tshogs rnams la byin// dga' rgyan lus dga'/ khyod sku'i byis pa'i mgul phreng la// dga' nas bcangs tshe khu bo yis// sgyu mas rkus nas slar dbugs phyin// sgyu ma'i dga' ston der cher 'phel// dga' rgyan gsung dga'/ bde mchog bde la rtsed grogs su// rdo rje phag mo mi dgos shes// bsam mi khyab 'dir gus tsam gyis// bdag cag dga' ba'i dga' ston 'phel//

nyams brgyad las dang po'i rgyan/ dus de nyid na sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor lang tsho sar pa'i mtshan dpe'i mtshar sdug ci yang ston mkhas mtshan ldan bla ma khu bo dbang gi rgyal po 'di ni bgrang phreng sprul sgyur 'di 'dras mtshon pa'i rig pa skad cig rang gzugs la dbang sangs rgyas kun dngos thar 'dod bdag gi snying gi grogs po yin snyam du// khyod ni bcos min rab dang dang ba'i chags pas myos pa'i rnam 'gyur 'di ltar mgon de'i drung du sleb pa tsam gyis lus tshugs ma thub glang chen dar mas glang mo chags pa'i myos dri tshor ltar lag pa'i sna zhags ci dgar brkyangs pa'i mgo bo sa chen nyid la btud te lan brgyar phyag ni 'tshal bar brtson// dam chos ston zhal 'dab brgya'i khur 'dzum zur mig ge sar g.yo bar mdzad pa'i tshems dkar nyi zer 'phro ba'i mod la khyod sku bung ba ba spu'i rkang drug 'dar zhing g.yo ba'i ngal stegs 'jam mnyen dran don tshig gi 'dab ma la 'jug thugs rjes bskul ba'i gsol 'debs bung sgra mchi ma'i sbrang rtsi skyug pas brel// kun dga'i mtshan ldan dang ba'i lang tshos ches rab myos khyod mtshan ldan bla ma gnyis bcas bcu po'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mdzes sgeg nyams kyis yid kyi shing rta lhag ma lus pa gang bar gyur nas chos kyi ro yi dga' dang bde ba 'ba' zhig la rtsen rol sgaig nyams kyis bde mchog 'khor lo'i ngo bor bzhugs//

sgeg pa'i nyams/ 'on kyang khyod thugs khro bo chen po'i nyams// cog rtse'i steng du yang zhing ldem por bsgyur// gser mdog phyag bzhi'i khro chen mkha' khyab par// spro ba'i snang ba zhabs 'bring pa la'ang bstan// dpa' ba'i nyams/ rdzu 'phrul zhabs stabs gar bskyod ma dgos shing*// rgyal ba spyan 'dren pho nya'ang ma btang bar// gser mdog lha skus nam mkha' gang ba dang*// shrī dbang dwags po lha rjer gzigs khyod dpa'// mi sdug pa'i nyams/ yongs 'dzin ji snyed yi dam lhar gzigs shing*// lhag pa'i lha dang 'bral mi rung bzhin du// bdag cag rmu rgod gdul bya'i khrod bzhugs pa// kye ma bdag cag thugs brtses dgongs khyod lta// rngam pa'i nyams/ mthu chen khyod la rgol bar brtsom pa'i dam nyams sgyu ma'i ga zha dag dang khrag gi thig le zhag gi zo ris ko rlon gos 'chang mche gtsigs ma// dmar nag 'khrug pa khrag mtsho'i klong dkyil ral gri mdung thung gri thod thogs nas bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu ba'i 'dod khams dbang phyug ral gcig ma// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ ru ru'i sgra sgrog glog stong 'khyugs pa'i ljags bskyod nas kyang khyod dgra'i snying khrag hub thaibs gcig gis gsol bar mdzad pa'i re ma ti// a phyi zhes byar mtshan gsol ma ni chu rta'i steng na rgod thul gsol te ma mo sha za 'bum sdes bskor nas rngam stabs can gyis bzhud pa gzigs// bzhad pa'i nyams/ grogs mo khyod sku'i me tog 'dab ma bdun khri nyis stong rnying pa mi mnga'i a wa dhū tī'i yu ba 'khrang pos dri bzhon rnam bcu'i yur bar drangs pa'i khu ba ci 'dod 'thungs pa'i mod la tshogs drug rang mdangs rkang pa rkyong ba'i chen po gsum rtse'i bung ba bder nyal de tshe ro rkyang dkar dmar snang ba ngang gis nub pa'i bag yangs gshis la gnas pa'i bsnyems pas rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid gzugs la nam yang 'dzem med blta bar phod pa'i g.yon mig ma khyod kyis// 'jig rten dngos grub byis pa'i dbang bdun bza' dang btung la ci dgar spyad kyang yid bde'i shing rta 'gengs ma nus par dgun khrid 'debs pa'i dus skabs shig na bka' brgyud bla ma mdza' bo'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun kyang sgom zhwa bzhes dbus dkar mdangs 'gram rings rlung bsus can gyi dwags po lha rje lhag par chags nas grwa pa'i grangs ston zol gyis mu tig phreng ba mdzad med khyod la stsal tshe dmar smug mdangs can phag mo gru pa 'dzum 'dzum bzhad mo bzhad 'dzum ston// khyod sngon mos gus srog gi 'khor los nan gyis drangs pa'i mdza' bo rnams kyi byin rlabs phyag gi sen mo'i lcags kyus khyod thugs bum dbang nyams kyis myos pa'i kun gzhi'i dkar 'dzin nu 'bur mkhrang po bde stong zung gi ting 'dzin 'gram der gril por btab pa'i ri mo'i rjes de bskyed rim yongs grub dag pa'i lha sku mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo nyid dang spyi bor dbu ma'i rtsa mdud grol ba'i dag snang yin phyir zubs ma nus par rab gsal mdza' bo'i sen rjes de// 'on kyang khyod ni bkyel mdzangs ldan pas rmi lam ting 'dzin stod g.yogs gyon tshe gos kyi rjes 'di mdza' bo'i sen rjes sar pa 'dra zhes bzhad gad tshul gyis bden gtam rlung la bskur ba'i sgyu thabs ston zhing res 'ga' stod g.yogs 'gebs mdzad chos kun ye gsang thabs kyis chod kyang dbang gis ma smin skal dman la lar sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi po bskyed pa'i rim pa skye rim zhes dad gzhan gyis mi zab 'dir zab ces sogs co 'dri rtsed mo nyid du mdzad//

rmad byung nyams/ khyod thugs gsang ba kun dga'i tshal yangs por// yon tan gsang ba ljon 'dab gsar pa'i gos// phrin las gsang ba rnag khrag khrus rdzing sogs// sangs dang rgyas pa'i ye shes gsang ba mtshar// 'jigs su rung ba'i nyams/ dgun khrid thon pa'i dus skabs shig na bsod nams brgyas byin nā ro ta'i// phyag gi mtshon cha phyag rgya chen po chos drug rdo rje'i rtse mo la// gtum mo'i me lce lhab lhab 'bar de lus med g.yul ngor dngar ba'i tshe// bag chags lha min lus mngal phug nas khrag mtshor 'khyil zhes khyod kyis gsungs// gzi brjid can gyi rgyan/ khyod sku lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol tshe a thung me lce tsam zhig sbar bas bdun khri nyis stong rang 'bar de tshe las kyi rlung rnams 'jigs ma byed// da ni res 'ga' gtum mo'i ral gri phyir la phyogs te yul 'khor bsod snyoms don yod za ba nyan thos ris can khyed skyabs ched// khyod ni de skad drang por gsungs mod de lta na'ang khyod kyis gsang ba bsgrags zhes blo dman rnams ni 'jigs par ma byed rmi lam zol du mdzad pa 'dis// ras phud nyams la skrag pa skye ba'i gsar bu rnams la dbugs dbyung yin zhes drang don gsung la bden par 'dzin pa khyed ltar ro// rnam grangs brjod rgyan/ khyod sku mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grol tshe thams cad yod smra mtshe'u kha bde mchog gtsug lag 'di nas ngur smrig snam sbyar dri ma med pas sku bklubs te// kun gyis bkur te sgrub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing der 'byon par brtsams tshe 'dab brgya'i bu mo gcig gis 'dzum phreng bstan pa'i mod la mang po'ang ston// ston 'dod mang ste snga phyi gnyis ka'i mtshon don skyob pa khyod la nges par mkha' 'gro ma rnams gsang ba'i mchod pas bstan par 'dod pa kho na'i brda'// 'on kyang rnal lam zol gyis sngar bzhin rigs kyi pad+mo'i nang bzhugs gdul bya smin grol mtshon sar nus shes skyob pa nyid kyi gsung la ston//

kun phan gyi rgyan/ khyod rang gcig pus klu sgrub skyob pa'i las// sgrub par bzhed tshe klu dang skyob sogs dang*// sangs rgyas stong dang phyag stong spyan stong sogs// mngon sum zhal rgyas khyod kyi bzhed don bsgrubs// rgya che'i rgyan gnyis/ sngon gyi rgyal ba kun gyis ma thul ba'i// 'gro 'di gdul snyam thugs bsam glang chen gyis// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan khur chen po// phyi nang gsang bas mtshon dgos khyod kyis bsnams// chos bsnyon dor/ me gzhil chu bsgyur reg pa tsam gyis gdon las grol dang mang po gcig bsdud gcig kyang du mar bsgyur ba'i gdong mdzes g.yo ldan 'di ni khyod sku ma lags legs smon dag pa'i lha min bu mo'i yid kyi shing rta 'dren byed bde ba'i lcags kyu yin// gang la cis 'dul chos 'khor rim gsum dgongs gcig bstan snying tshad ma bzhis 'chad 'phral du phan dang mchog gi lam ston tshangs dbyangs 'di ni khyod gsungs ma lags ro rkyang chu 'dzin dbu mar 'khrigs pa'i bde stong 'thab pa dga' bzhi'i gad rgyangs 'brug sgra yin// mtshe'u khar bzhugs dus sta zur gnyis nas mdog gnag snum pa'i bya rog dag gis khyod skur brten zhing bsnyen bkur bgyid pa'i 'dab chags 'di ni dud 'gro ma lags mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas gsung ltar shar sgo skyong ma kha kha mu kha'i rang gzugs yin// a phyi ma dang 'phral 'phral mjal dang sprul sku rdo rje rgyal po sngar gzigs bsam yas rab gnas gdan 'dren gzigs sogs lung bstan 'di kun rnal lam ma lags gzigs snang tsam min mngon shes thogs med mnga' sogs yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhir bgrang bya yin// yul snyon dor khyod kyi ting 'dzin nyams kyi ltad mor bla ma kun dang lha kun yang gzigs chos skyong phyag bzhi gser mdog brjid pas nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab pa nyid dang lha lcam a phyi pho nya kun dang me tog sgron me mchod rdzas kun dang bsngags pa lha bzo dus gsum snang brnyan 'khor 'das snang ba ci yang gzigs tshe gzigs gzigs bya yul gyi skye mched ma 'dres gzhal med khang gi brtsegs pa dang 'grogs ngo mtshar yod 'ong de nyid ni// chos la ma sbyangs skye bo phal dang dang po'i las can rnal 'byor blo ngor yid la bsil zhing bde bar 'bab pa'i tsan+dan zla 'od dal bu'i dri gzhon lkog gyur blang dor ston pa'i mngon shes snying gi gdung ba sel byed 'di ni kun dga'i zhabs kyi las bzang 'bras bu kun rdzob rnam smin rgod ma kha yi rlabs phreng yin pas bdag cag rnams la bsil ba'i mngon mkhyen khyod la tsha ba'i zhugs su rtog

/chos la sbyangs pa la la dag kyang bdag cag rnams kyi goms bya'i yul du rtog la 'char ba'i ri mo rdo rje'i gzhi la 'dod yon stegs bur rtsig pa lnga po pha gu ser pos mnan pa'i steng du drwa ba drwa phyed rtse mo pu shu bcas pa'i nang rol phyag rgya rnam pa'i lha tshogs kun dang phyi ru 'byung bzhi dur khrod la sogs dag dang ma dag sgom rgyu de nyid skyob la gzigs snang du shar ro// khyod la dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig li tsa bī dang klu sgrub skyob sogs mngal 'jug nas brtsams mya ngan 'da' bar kun rdzob mi mngon mi snang mi gsal don dam snang chen gsal ba chen po gzugs med gzugs bzang sna tshogs gzugs brnyan gshis la med na bltas pas ci 'char stong gsum dar yug chen po'i mdo bzhin lha mig dag pa khyod kyi gzigs mod las dag 'ga' la khyod lhums 'jug tshe 'ja' 'od snang ba shar bas mtshon de yin// de lta'i khyod kyi gzigs yul lha mi 'khor 'das snang brnyan ci shar de kun ro rkyang lam nas rlung bcu zhugs te gzung 'dzin gnyis su blta mkhan ma yin las dang nyon mongs bag chags dbang gis khams gsum snang bar shar ma yin// dbu ma'i khyim du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ci bder gzims pa'i rmi lam lags shing skal ldan mngon shes lung ston 'khrul snang gzhan dang cha 'thun 'byung mod 'khrul med ye shes kho na'o// rang bzhin bsnyon dor/ khyod kyi phrin las thugs rje'i chus rlan phan bde'i bcud ldan bdud rtsi zag pa'i bsil zer can// zla ba zhes byar las smon dag pa bdag cag 'dod do bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba gzhan// drag po'i phrin las bya rog 'phrul ldan las ngan 'phro gcod dug 'dzag mi bsrun tsha zer can// nyang por byon tshe dad ldan rnams dang sang seng sgar par zla ba nyid de nyi ma'ang bsnyon// sbyar rgyan dang po tshig tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba/ shar phyogs mi nyag ring por ja 'dren bsnyen bkur yon gyi gnas su 'char gnas tho rangs tshe// ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor la chags rgyal po khyod kyi shing rta a phyi chibs zhon khams mo'i tshul// dri med 'od lnga kho mos spro zhes 'go nad zhi ba'i phrin las rta bdun rten mkhas pas// 'jam pa'i dpya yis ja pa rnams kyi yid rab phrogs nas chos la sbyar//

tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar ba/ bdud rigs 'phags rigs sad la mi gnas pa// sang seng ban+de skyon gyi 'byung gnas dang*// gdod nas log sgrub skyon mang dag gis khyod// thugs sun dbyung phyir sku dang gsung la brgal// sbyar rgyan tha dad mang tshig bde mchog gzhal med khang na rab gnas pa// skyob pa'i sku la bsdongs nas rtse ba ru// nyi shar mtshams la zhal nas bya gsum thon// gcig gis sang seng ba rnams cis ma mnar// dpe sbyar/ ji ltar klu sgrub dus na'ang phyag bzhi pa// bya rog gzugs kyis nā len+d+ra bskyangs ltar// khyod las gsum 'thon gnyis po slar nang srung*// gcig gis sgro shad bstan pa'i dgra bo bsgral// gzugs can sbyar/ thugs ka 'dab brgyad sgo yi dur khrod kyi// bya rog bu mo las la kun tu gnag /sang seng dgon du mkhar bsgyel mi phyugs god// thabs shes skyob pa'i sku la ring du gnos// bya ba gcig smin 'khyog yid 'ong mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i zhal// rigs ldan skyob la chags pa gsal ston nas// bskul ba'i mig dang dbugs 'byin pho nyas kyang*// 'bri gdan 'khrugs pas skyo ba'i mdza' bo bkug / bya ba 'gal min sbyar/ khyod la mgon khang rnying ma'i khyi nag po// yid 'ong ting 'dzin drag po'i phrin las spel// gu ru drag pos lcags kyu zhags pa yang*// thod phreng rtsal 'grub srid gsum dbang bsdud stsol// bya ba thog la sbyar/ phyag bzhi pa dang a phyi chos sgron dmar po dgra zor phyogs kyi 'gron po mdza' bo rnams// khyod kyi phrin las dga' ma'i lus la lhag par sbyar ba'i dmar mdangs ston par byed pa na// 'ol kha'i dmag dpung nyi ma'i gom stabs tsha zer nub ri'i mal stan bzung nas gnyid log gyur// gnyid kyi za zir ban dmag skar ma'i phreng bas bskor ba'i mgon rgyal zla zer gtong ba'ang rmis// sbyar ba nges can/

mgon rgyal nyid la mgon pos dngos su bskul// mi mang rnams la kong dmag bang chen gnyis// sde pa 'di pa'i sde srid dpung tshogs bzhi// 'ol kha'i sgar sar 'ol gyis skad cig sleb// nges 'gog skyob pa khyod kyi srung ma g.yul ngor lhags rnams de tshe mda' mdung ral gri so yis 'ol kha'i rdzong dpon 'khor bcas dag la gnod pa med par gtam dang nom pa'i tsher ma rnon pos pad+ma'i yu ba 'jam zhing mnyen par bab dang mi gte'i sen mo 'o dag gang gang de'i nges bzung bral bas rtsen zhing zol ba'i thabs kyis 'dzin// 'on kyang skyes bu lus skyes rgyas pa yid 'ong dga' ma'i lus kyi ldum rar rang dbang zhugs tshe ji ltar 'dod pa'i bstan bcos lugs ltar 'o byed brgyad kyis bsgyur ba'i brgyad tshan drug cu rtsa bzhi mtho ba 'di yang zag med yon tan drug cu bzhi po gshis la gnas der rol zhing rtsen pa di wu'i byings las lha yi sgyu 'phrul la/ sa 'dzin rnams la rdo ba'i bye brag 'jam rtsub zlum nar ci yang mngon la gzi brjid ldan pa'i rgyal po'i srid na dar rgud dman 'byor gang yang snang ngo khams gsum rnam shes rgyal khams 'di la re zhig dbang byed tshogs brgyad po rnams kun gzhi dpon g.yog srog ma gcod par gzhi mi spong ba rtsed 'jo'i zol gyis ye shes khyod drung khrid// de tshe ye shes skyob pa khyod kyis ngo sprod bka' stsal 'di ltar phebs te mgon rgyal la sogs dmag mi khyed cag de tsam nga rgyal bya rin mi chog kho bos grogs byed 'di 'di brdzangs zhes 'o de gung rgyal slob bur khugs nas lug mang phul ba'i gleng gzhi dang bcas shes byar srid tshad rgyal ba'i mdzad pa'ang ngo sprod 'dir yang mdzad// 'gal min bya sbyar/ khyod srid phyogs las rnam rgyal byed po grogs rgyal don du 'phan yul 'dzin ma'i thig ler chas// kun tu dkar ba'i dbyangs can lha mo a phyi'i zla ba cha tsam ltos 'gro'i gos kyis bkab// skyob pa khyod la 'dzum zhal ston dus srid sde'i grogs la cung zad skyon pa'i tshig mda' 'phen// bstan pa'i jo bo nus pas 'dzin yang skye dgu'i bdag po 'byung zhes lung bstan der mdzad do//

'gal can bya sbyar rgyan/ rnal 'byor ldan yang las sgrib ma byang snyun gyis gzir ba'i ras chen la// mgo dgur ston yang ye shes spyan bral lba ba brtsegs pa'i gdon gyis gtses// lta ba skyo yang mos gus drag pos bla mar gsol ba btab pa'i mod// khyod thugs zhi yang drag por sprul bas gdon rang grol nas 'tshub mar bzhud//

khyad par rgyan yon tan/ spre'u lo'i sku mtshams grol ba'i rdzes der ti sgro nas brgyud sgrub chu ji snyed kun// ha cang tsha ba'ang ma yin bsil min na yang gur gum dri mdangs kho nas khebs// chu des bkrus shing btungs pas nad 'ga' sel mod na yang khyod nyid ni// bum dang gsang ba'i nyer rgyu'i dbang bzhes gnas sdod zol gyis khyad chos sbed par mdzad// byed par rgyan rigs/ tsha chu'i rjes shig mtshe'u khar phebs nas dus mi thung bar snyung ba drag pos btab ston 'di// rlung gi ris min bad kan yang min mkhris pa'i ris min 'dus pa'i ris kyang min// de lta mod kyi gnas ngan len gyi bag chags phra mo'ang sbyong bar nus pa'i grib thor 'dis// 'phyong rtse 'og min zhing du bsgyur nas bde mchog yab yum khyad par dbang la bskul bar nus// khyad par rgyan bya ba/ dus der khyod sku g.yas phyogs ka ba'i ngos kyi cog rtse'i steng na bu chung lo bdun pa yi tshad// srab 'jam na bza' sel mkhan med par mtshan dang dpe byad ma 'dres gsal por yongs rdzogs khyod la bstan// gdos bcas khrag la longs mi spyod kyang drag po'i phyag rgya drug gis mtshon pa'i khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ snang yang rang dang gzhan du 'dzin bral rang nyid sgyu ma'i lha skur bzhengs pa khyod sku'i gshis su dgongs// khyad par rang bzhin/ g.yon gyi ka ba'i ngos na mtshan ldan yid 'phrog mi yi bu mo shin du gzhon pa'i lang tsho can// 'dod chags shing rta med cing gti mug glang po med la zhe sdang rta med nga rgyal rkang thang med// stong pa'i zur mig gcig pu nyid kyis khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyis srid pa gsum po 'gong nus ma// gang des khyod la dbang bzhi bzhes pa'i dus min nam zhes yang yang bskul ba shin tu ngo mtshar rmad// rgyu'i khyad par brjod rgyan/ de tshe khyod sku las nyon phra mo'i rjes 'brang de yang gzung 'dzin rang rtsal nyams pa'i tshul gyis phyag gi sor mos rtsen pa tsam la'ang ngal ba'i 'phrul gyis nem nem nyul// gzung bya'i yul la 'dzin byed thug pa'i gzung 'dzin snang ba so so ma 'khrungs rang rig rang gsal bde ba cher 'khrungs mos gus drag pos gsol btab dbang ni zhus pa'i tshe// rgyal ba kun yum zag med bde ba'i shing rta 'khor lo gcig pu can ma theg brgyad man chad spros pa'i mtshan ma kha lo pa dang rta yi tshogs la ma reg par// dus sbyor bcu gnyis 'gog pa'i gzi byin bde ba can 'od gsal ba'i nyi ba lung ston bu mo rdo rje phag mos nyer rgyu'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur te mngon byang chub//

cha rim nas khyad par rgyan gyi bar mang po 'di rnams gsang ba'i rnam thar 'khor lo gsum pa rang sngags ltar bstod pa'o// //mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan/ 'dzam gling 'di ru sngar byon rang rgyal ji snyed dang*// shā ri'i bu dang mauṅgal bu dang 'od srung che// sprul sku thub dbang nyid dang skyob pa khyod nyid kyang*// mya ngan 'da' khar sku yi rdzu 'phrul ston par mdzad// mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan gnyis pa/ rtogs ldan 'phags pa zhes byas 'khrul 'khor rol rtsed dang*// skyob khyod khri las mkha' la bya bzhin 'phar ba dang*// lho sprin sdod dang glog gi rtse dga' rnams kyang ni// sgo glegs 'phrogs pa'i skad cig gnyis par ma gnas so// 'gal rgyan yon tan/ de ltar sku yi rdzu 'phrul bstan yang rtogs ldan 'phags las 'khrul 'khor len// rang re dpon slob grub rtags 'gran zhes dgyes pa'i bzhad gad ci yang mdzad// dmag zings phrin las shig mang khyod kyi las ngan mthu zhes khrel nas bzhad// da lo so sor thod pa 'bor zhes skyo ba'i bzhad gad mdzad do// byed las 'gal rgyan/ bka' brgyud bstan la lhag par chags khyod chags sred nyes pa sel la mkhas// bcos ma'i chos la gcig tu sdang khyod zhe sdang 'dul phyir shin du btsun// dam tshig 'dral la ngan par brtsi khyod rme gtsang ro snyoms lta ba bzang*// bstan pa gnas phyir dus rings brtsom na'ang 'gro 'dul dka' gzigs thugs sna thung*// rnam pa 'gal rgyan/ sangs rgyas byang sems ches rab mang yang bstan pa dam chos dgongs pa gcig /bstan 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs ldan gcig pu sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya can// kho bos tshogs 'dir yang yang mang bshad lan re'ang sems la 'jog mkhan nyung*// zang zing rlung ltar g.yeng bas mdo med sgrub pa ri ltar snying por tshugs// yon tan 'gal rgyan/ da lta dpon slob phrad 'dzom mod kyang sang gnangs dkon pa'i dus gcig 'ong ngo gdams ngag mang po gcig tu dril// chos ra 'di kar lus gnad bsgrims la sems nyid lhod mor ngo blta'i bya ras sgom rgyu med la sgo zhig thob// kho bo zhing khams gzhan du dga' yang khyed rnams shul du lus snyam skye bo da lta 'dzom dus dri bshad gyis// mang du glengs kyang don rtsa gcig po tshe 'di yun thung sangs rgyas thag ring sgrub pa snying por longs zhes gsungs//

rdzas 'gal rgyan/ khyod ni dbyar chos mtshams grol dus na'ang dpon slob lhan cig mnyam bzhag mdzad// lam dang gral sogs 'phos pa'i dus na'ang dam chos nyag gcig gsung la brtson// chos med mi 'ga' skyid mdog 'don yang shi nas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig myong*// gzhon lus bde bde 'dra 'dra tsho yang lod lod sdug po snyag snyag 'dra// sbyar ba'i 'gal rgyan/ lus mdzes ston ka'i zla ltar mdzes kyang 'chi bdag dgra gcan lag pas zin tshe 'khor mang rgya mtsho lta bu'i dkyil nas grogs med re'u spyang kis khyer ltar mun nag gshin rje'i dong du 'jug phyir char mun 'thibs 'dra'i bar do'i 'phrang la 'gro dgos soms la dam pa'i chos re gyis// longs spyod rgya mtsho lta bu yod rung sbyin pa chu thigs tsam zhig mi thengs chos pa'i nga rgyal ri bo mtho yang bdag 'dzin khron pa'i gting du zhugs nas kha bshad chu 'dzin ches mang bsags rung zab don char med 'brug sgra bor la snying po don gyi gdams ngag zab mo tshol// shes rab chung la dran pa rmongs kyang 'dod chags che la zhe sdang rags pas tshe gang skad cig chos ma dran rung nyon mongs mtshon brgya rtag tu bzung nas dal 'byor stong log byed phod dpa' bo dmyal bar rgyang mchongs 'bros pa'i bdar ma 'di la snying rje lhag par bskyed pa'ang rigs// dgra bos zhe sdang me mtshon spar rung byams pa'i sprin gtibs gzhan phan char phob tshul khrims byis pa gnyen 'dun chags pa'i chu bos bskyod na bskyed rim gru thong mtshan 'dzin rlung la mos gus gser gyi rdo rje phyag rgya chen po bsngo bas 'khor ba srid du gnas par rgyas thob cig / skabs min bstod rgyan/ srid pa'i bde 'dod rlung gis cher bteg yar rgyab mi bdag chu chen de yang dben gnas 'di yi rtse mo'i ngo mtshar blta ba'ang mthong*// mgon khyod thugs rje'i rab gsal me dpung 'bar ba'ang 'brog khams dman khyim lcong rong khung bur bag phab 'brel tshad don ldan 'jug pa mtshar// chos khrims rin chen gshin rje 'chi kha'i rlung gis rnam shes g.yo ba bla ma khyod nyid dran pa'i mos gus ri bo lhag par gnas// khyod thugs g.yo med ting 'dzin sa gzhir slob bu gang de'i rnam shes bar do'i 'phrang sgrol dri bzhon mkha' spyod gnas su bskyel nus mtshar//

zol bstod rgyan dang po/ khyod ni 'dod yon kun la sred pa mi mnga' yang*// gsol ja bzang po dus su bzhes la dgyes pa snyam// gsol ja gzungs dar gdon gyis btab nas dbugs song yang*// byin rlabs tsam gyis sos par mdzad pa ma lags sam// zol bstod gyi rgyan gnyis pa/ khyod kyi bzo bo sprul sku rdo rje rgyal// gdon gyis bzung nas gzhan gyis ma phan tshe// gdon bskrad lha bzo 'phral du bde mdzad pa// khyod la chags sdang mi mnga' de rdzun nam// nges bstan rgyan/ gang zhig gang gis bskyed cing gang la gang phan 'dogs byed de dang de ni de de'i gnyen dang grogs// rtse mo can gyis gzi brjid dang ni nyin mor byed pas pad+mo'i tshal la ji lta ba bzhin du// thub pa'i bstan la rgyal ba nyid dang 'phags pa'i yul du klu sgrub byon pa yang ni de kho na// rin chen dpal dang kun dga'i zhabs khyod phyag rgya chen po'i gnas mal don du bka' btags zhwa sogs spel// lhan cig brjod rgyan dang po/ dus de nyid na rtsod dus mtshon byed nam yang mi gtong rgyal ba'i lung bstan u rgyan lung dang dus mtshungs su// ming tsam gyis ni go tam slob mar khas mche mang dag chu srin rgyal mtshan gyis bstan lam du bsam sbyor mtshungs// mtshon gyi bskal pa brdo ba'i dus dang kun dga'i nyi ma ba lang spyod gling bzhud par rtsom pa'ang dus mnyam du// rje btsun khyod ni dpa' bo mkha' 'gros ti sgro 'gram gyi khrus kyi rdzing bur spyan drangs ji bzhin dus la byon// lhan cig brjod rgyan gnyis pa/ me tog mda' can smon lam 'phong rgyang dang*// zhing gzhan spyan 'dren lcags kyu ring pos 'dir// khyod thugs zin dang khyod sku khrus rdzing du// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i mchid lan mgur du bzhes// yongs brjes kyi rgyan/ rnam rtog lus kyi ri bo mtho khyod rang dgar sdod cig mkhyen brtse'i nyi zla zung zhig nga ni mkha' la 'gro// gling bzhi yongs la phyin pa'i rjes su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad zhabs drung de gar yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs// rdo rje'i glu 'di bu slob khyed rang rna bar zhog dang dad pa'i gsal 'debs dus sam rgyun gyi rna rgyan yin// bro cig 'khrobs la gsol ba thob dang gsol btab me tog phreng mdzes de yang kho bo'i rna ba'i rgyan du 'chang*//

shis brjod rgyan/ de nas mtshe'u kha bde mchog zhing du rings par spyan drangs gdul bya'i bsod nams spel slad sku yi rim gro ches mang dag kyang srid zhur bzhes// phrin las kha lo mgon po'i mtshan
