gyis zhus pa'i lan du bstan pa'i mdzad 'phro tsan+dan mdzad bcu'i rten la sogs pa bsgrub ces bka' bstsal mdzad// me phag ston 'bring tshes drug dgung thun lnga bcu rtsa gsum dgung lo'i khri steng snam sbyar bka' btags sgom zhwa gsol nas dbon la bstan pa btad// de nas dbon dang mgon po rgyal mtshan dkon mchog bka' bsrung bden byin brlabs kyis sgrib byang yon tan kun rgyas gyur zhes bde chen dbyings su bzhugs// rab spel rgyan/ de nas nyin zhag mang po'i ring la chos skyong sprul pa mgon rgyal la sogs zhabs 'bring pa rnams bzhin gyi pad mtsho mchi ma'i skyar rdzas phangs med 'phyur nas gdung shugs ge sar rgyas pa'i rtse mor nyams snang khyod sku'i bung ba lding la gsung gi nyi ma nub pa'i dbang gis dga' ba'i 'dab ma so sor kha zum lus mdzes 'dab brgya'i sdong po cher 'dar gyad kyi yul du thub dbang ji bzhin gzim chung nang der sprul pa bsdus tshe 'khor gyi lus dang sa chen 'di yang dus mnyam rnam pa drug tu g.yos so// slar yang khyod kyi thugs rje'i pho nya gdul bya pad+mo'i tshal 'di skyong phyir nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes pa'i kun gsal dpal mo 'ja' tshon gos gyon me tog phreng mdzes do shal tshar tshar lha rdzas spos kyi dud pa chil chil skyob pa'i sku la 'bul bar snyam snyam pi wang gling bu skyu ru ru ba nyin mtshan lha yi rnga sgra dir dir mkha' 'gro'i ḍa ma ru sgra khral khral bu slob mang po'i rna bar lhang lhang 'dzin med stong pa'i ngang du khrol khrol thugs rjes mya ngan sangs pa'ang snyam mo// bdag cag 'di ltar mgon skyabs bral ba'i sdug bsngal drag pos gzir ba'i dus na sngo sangs bu mo gdong pa bkrus te bai ḍūr+ya'i bzhin shin du gtsang bas lha rdzas me tog tshems dkar phreng ba sun pa med par nam yang ston na khyod dang nged la 'khon lan ci yod nam zla dgun gyi ne'u sing rnams kyang ha cang dga' ba'i bzhin gyi dbus nas me tog sar pa'i zur mig mang pos nged la sngon du yun ring blta 'am nags kyi rkang 'thung ldum ra so so'i me tog 'di yang su la 'bul lam// de lta mod kyi sprul sku'i nyi ma lan cig nub kyang yang yang 'char zhes gdul bya rnams la gsal bar bstan phyir smin pa'i nas 'bru ting phor nang du phung por spungs nas khyod la mchod tshe ting phor nang gi nas las myu gu rim gyi snye ma'i bar du 'khrungs pa 'di lta'i sgyu 'phrul ngo mtshar ltad mo dad dang ma dad bar ma'i gdul bya kun la mthun snang nyi ma bzhin grub rgyu des gdul bya gzhan dang gzhan yang sngar med dad pa'i myu gu skyes te thar pa'i lo thog rgyas par mdzad do//

dgongs pa can gyi rgyan/ de ltar skyob pa kun dga' rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal dang bzang por mtshan ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs rir bzhugs pa la// mchod rdzas mos gus srog gi 'khor lo rta ljang can gyi tsha zer phreng ba ri rgyal gling bzhi gling phran brgyad rnams dang*// ri shing ba lo rgyal srid sna bdun gter bum gzungs brgyad nyi zla gdugs rgyal don rgyan so lnga'i tshom bu bkod pa yin// maṇ+ḍal zhes su grags 'di bshams 'di bshams nas dper brjod so sos phul ba lags so bzhes nas dngos grub ci 'dod stsol// me long na rgya skad du yod kyang 'gyur thal bas ma thon/ /de nas sgra rgyan rgyan bzang yang*// yang dag mchod gsol gsol 'debs don// don mang tshig nyung nyung bsdus 'di// 'di tsam zhig tu du ma 'dus// thog ma'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ kye kye skyob pa rdo rje 'chang*// lam lam spyi bo'i rgyan 'di ru// wal wal gsal ni btab nas kyang*// lhang lhang gsol ba 'debs lags na// 'phral 'phral dngos grub stsal du gsol// tha ma'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ skyob pa dran dus yid la wal wal wal// gsol ba 'debs pa'i glu chung skyu ru ru// byin rlabs chu rgyun rgyun chags na ra ra// rang sems 'od gsal ngang du sa la la// bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rkyang rgyan/ kun khyab kun gzhi'i gnas lugs ngo sprod phyir// dga' bzhi'i dga' ston gdul bya skal bzang la// rin thang rin gyis rnyed dka' mchog stsol mkhan// chen gsum chen pos ma reg khyod kyis stsal// dbyangs nges pa bya dka' ba/ mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa la// gus 'dud phul byung myur du 'bul// snying gi dkyil 'dir yid kyis dmigs// ye shes bde ster khyed mkhyen zhes// mchod gsol rtsal 'don 'o dod 'bod// khrig phrog brang mgrin dpral skar drongs// lhan thabs pa la nas ba btags// myur spyis phyag byed khyed skyabs gyis// ka la piṅka'i dbyangs snyan po// kha tsam min pa'i gdung shugs kyis// ga shed rgyang ring 'bod tshul ltar// nga ro drag pos gsol ba 'debs// ca ma li yi zol sbyor min// cha lugs mdzes mtshon yang min par// ja sogs legs spyod dus na yang*// nya bzhi bsgrims pa'i lus phyag bcas// ta thā ga ta nyid dngos dang*// tha dad min pa'i bla ma la// da lta nyid du gsol ba 'debs// na yang re sa khyed rang lags// pa la sha yi nags gseb tu// pha rol skye bos dbyen byas na// ba spu g.yo bzhin gsol btab na// ma lus dngos grub khyod kyis stsol// tsa ra ka pa'i tshig rgyan tsam// tsha grang sdug bsngal sel thabs min// dza lang min pa'i zhi dul gyis// wa ler gsol ba btab na 'grub// zha nye ma 'dres dngul myur dag nas// sa chen 'phags lam thob par mdzod// ha lo la sogs me tog dang*// a ka ru sogs bdug spos 'bul// u dum bā ra dang 'dra ba'i// e ma skyob pas byin gyis rlobs// rgyal sras sprul klu skyob
